Proxy Policy Steering VLA

generalist robot policy inference-time adaptation proxy policy steering velocity-space residual denoising step

简要说明：代理策略引导（PPS）是一种针对冻结通用机器人策略的推理时自适应方法。它通过两个轻量级代理策略计算校准的速度空间残差来引导基础策略，从而在仅使用少量演示的情况下实现特定任务行为，同时不损害广泛的操控能力。

TLDR: Proxy Policy Steering (PPS) is an inference-time adaptation method for frozen generalist robot policies. It uses two lightweight proxy policies to compute a calibrated velocity-space residual that steers the base policy, enabling task-specific behavior from limited demonstrations without degrading broad manipulation capabilities.

Abstract: Generalist robot policies carry broad manipulation priors from large-scale data, but specializing them to a new task remains the deployment bottleneck. This requires eliciting task-specific behavior from limited demonstrations without degrading their broad capabilities. We introduce Proxy Policy Steering (PPS), an inference-time adaptation method that resolves this challenge by training two lightweight proxy policies whose calibrated velocity-space difference steers the frozen base sampler. A reference proxy models the frozen base's behavior on target-task observations, and a task proxy, initialized from the reference, captures how this behavior changes under task supervision. Their difference forms a calibrated velocity-space residual that steers the frozen base sampler at every denoising step. We identify the conditions under which this residual isolates the change induced by task supervision, and validate them empirically. Because the base is never directly modified, its broad capabilities remain available at inference, including behaviors such as recovery from failure that the demonstrations themselves do not exercise. Adaptation requires only forward velocity predictions from the base, making PPS lightweight to train and applicable even without access to the base's parameters. On 8 real-world and 4 simulation manipulation tasks, PPS lifts the state-of-the-art pi 0.5 base policy by 53% absolute success rate on average, with zero-to-one gains on tasks the base never solves, while preserving the base's broad capabilities. PPS outperforms LoRA fine-tuning, from-scratch specialists, residual policies, and prior inference-time steering methods.

摘要（中文）：通用型机器人策略通过大规模数据习得了广泛的操作先验知识，但将其适配至新任务仍是部署瓶颈。这需要从有限演示中提取任务特定行为，同时不削弱其通用能力。我们提出代理策略引导（PPS），一种推理时自适应方法，通过训练两个轻量级代理策略来解决这一挑战：其校准后的速度空间差异可引导冻结的基础采样器。参考代理模拟基础模型在目标任务观测下的行为，而任务代理（从参考代理初始化）则捕获该行为在任务监督下的变化。两者差异形成校准后的速度空间残差，在每个去噪步骤中引导冻结的基础采样器。我们识别了该残差能够隔离任务监督所引发变化的必要条件，并通过实验验证。由于基础模型从未被直接修改，其通用能力在推理时始终可用，包括演示本身未涉及的行为（如失败恢复）。自适应仅需基础模型的前向速度预测，使得PPS训练轻量化，且无需访问基础模型参数即可使用。在8项真实世界和4项仿真操作任务中，PPS将当前最先进的pi 0.5基础策略的平均绝对成功率提升53%，在基础模型从未解决的任务上实现从零到一的突破，同时保留其通用能力。PPS性能优于LoRA微调、从头训练的专用策略、残差策略及此前推理时引导方法。

Authors: Chuanruo Ning, Tianrui Wang, Wei-Chiu Ma, Kuan Fang

Visible-Reachable Workspace for Perception-Aware Humanoid Design HumanoidEmbodied

visible-reachable workspace actuated cameras humanoid design perception-aware reachability

简要说明：本文提出了可见可达工作空间（VRW）指标，用于设计带有主动摄像头的仿人机器人，实验表明主动感知显著提升了实际仿人平台上的感知与操作效率。

TLDR: This paper introduces the Visible-Reachable Workspace (VRW) metric for designing humanoid robots with actuated cameras, demonstrating that articulated sensing greatly improves perception and manipulation efficiency in a real humanoid platform.

Abstract: Workspace analysis measures where a robot can place its end effector. For visually guided manipulation, reachability alone is insufficient: a kinematically reachable target may not be visible in the specific pose required to reach it. The robot must then redirect its sensing or move its body to acquire a view, turning a perception limitation into additional motion. Existing humanoids largely inherit this limitation when copying human form factors. We introduce the visible-reachable workspace (VRW), a design-stage measure that conditions visibility on feasible reaching configurations and extends it to concurrent visibility of spatially separated work regions. We apply VRW by building a 31-DoF humanoid with independently actuated RGB-D cameras. On the same robot, camera articulation increases visible-reachable coverage from 38% to 97%. With actuated camera layouts, a second camera raises pairwise coverage from 0.45 to 0.95, while a third changes it only to 0.97. In a controlled two-target reach-and-grasp benchmark, our dual-actuated design reduces mean completion time by 17% and mechanical energy by 19% relative to the same robot with its cameras fixed. Hardware experiments demonstrate simultaneous observation and manipulation of front/back and left/right target pairs without torso reorientation. The results suggest that reachability becomes a more informative design quantity for perception-driven humanoid manipulation when it is evaluated together with the sensing configurations that make the reachable space observable. We will open-source all software and the humanoid hardware design. Our website is https://generalroboticslab.com/DukeHumanoidv2

摘要（中文）：工作空间分析用于衡量机器人末端执行器可到达的位置。在视觉引导操作中，仅靠可达性是不够的：一个运动学上可达的目标可能在执行抓取所需的特定姿态下并不可见。此时，机器人必须重新定向其感知或移动身体以获取视野，从而将感知限制转化为额外的运动。现有的仿人机器人在模仿人体形态时大多继承了这一局限。我们引入了可见-可达工作空间（VRW），这是一种设计阶段的度量方法，它将可见性条件建立在可行的抓取构型上，并将其扩展到空间分离的工作区域的并发可见性。我们通过构建一个31自由度的仿人机器人并配备独立驱动的RGB-D摄像头来应用VRW。在相同的机器人上，摄像头关节化使得可见-可达覆盖率从38%提升至97%。在采用驱动式摄像头布局时，第二个摄像头将成对覆盖率从0.45提升至0.95，而第三个摄像头仅将其提升至0.97。在一个受控的双目标抓取基准测试中，与相同机器人配备固定摄像头相比，我们的双驱动设计将平均完成时间降低了17%，机械能消耗降低了19%。硬件实验表明，无需躯干重新定向即可同时观测和操作前后及左右目标对。研究结果表明，当可达性与使可达空间可观测的感知构型一同评估时，可达性将成为感知驱动型仿人机器人操作中更具信息量的设计指标。我们将开源所有软件及仿人机器人硬件设计。我们的网站为：https://generalroboticslab.com/DukeHumanoidv2

Authors: Boxi Xia, Zijiang Yang, Ryan Shin, Bokuan Li, Eric Wun-Hao Lu, Jacob Lee, Jiaxun Liu, Boyuan Chen

RoboCousin: Build Your Own Simulation Playground for Robust Bimanual Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

bimanual manipulation sim-to-real data-generation platform grasp-contact candidates digital cousins

简要说明：RoboCousin 是一个仿真数据生成平台，可将用户提供的图像转换为双机械臂操作的可复用资产、场景和专家轨迹，实现可扩展的合成数据生成和仿真到现实的迁移。

TLDR: RoboCousin is a simulation data-generation platform that converts user-provided images into reusable assets, scenes, and expert trajectories for bimanual manipulation, enabling scalable synthetic data generation and sim-to-real transfer.

Abstract: Bimanual manipulation policies require large and diverse training datasets, yet collecting demonstrations on physical robots is expensive and difficult to scale. Simulation can generate data efficiently, but existing pipelines typically operate within closed asset libraries and predefined scenes: adding a newly observed object or environment still requires substantial effort to reconstruct geometry, specify physical and semantic properties, annotate interactions, and integrate the result into executable tasks. We present RoboCousin, an extensible simulation-based data-generation platform that turns user-provided observations into reusable assets, scenes, and expert trajectories for bimanual manipulation. Built on RoboTwin~2.0, RoboCousin converts object images into simulation-ready assets with visual and collision geometry, semantic and physical metadata, and automatically generated grasp-contact candidates. It further constructs digital cousins that vary compatible objects, backgrounds, layouts, and language instructions while preserving task-relevant affordances and spatial relations. The same asset system supports tabletop and room-level scene construction, with collision-aware base control for interaction beyond a fixed workspace. We release RoboCousin-OBD, containing more than 3,000 annotated object instances and 50 background environments, and use RoboCousin to generate over one million expert trajectories across 50 tasks. Simulation and real-robot experiments show that the automatically generated interaction annotations are comparable to curated annotations, generated assets provide effective sim-to-real supervision, and tabletop cousins can improve transfer beyond training on a single reconstructed scene. RoboCousin therefore provides a practical path for expanding both the scale and coverage of synthetic bimanual manipulation data.

摘要（中文）：双臂操作策略需要大规模且多样化的训练数据集，然而在实体机器人上收集示教数据成本高昂且难以扩展。仿真技术可以高效生成数据，但现有流水线通常局限于封闭的资产库和预设场景：若要添加新观察到的物体或环境，仍需耗费大量精力重建几何结构、指定物理与语义属性、标注交互方式，并将结果整合到可执行任务中。本文提出RoboCousin——一个可扩展的基于仿真的数据生成平台，能够将用户提供的观察数据转化为可复用的资产、场景及双臂操作专家轨迹。基于RoboTwin 2.0，RoboCousin可将物体图像转换为具备视觉与碰撞几何、语义及物理元数据的仿真就绪资产，并自动生成抓取接触候选点。该平台进一步构建数字孪生变体，在保持任务相关功能属性与空间关系的同时，变更兼容物体、背景、布局及语言指令。同一资产系统支持桌面级与房间级场景构建，并通过碰撞感知基座控制实现超出固定工作空间的交互。我们发布RoboCousin-OBD数据集，包含3000余个标注物体实例与50个背景环境，并利用RoboCousin在50个任务上生成了超过一百万条专家轨迹。仿真与实体机器人实验表明：自动生成的交互标注与人工策划标注性能相当，生成的资产可提供有效的仿真到现实监督，而桌面级数字孪生变体能提升在单一重建场景训练之外的迁移效果。因此，RoboCousin为扩展合成双臂操作数据的规模与覆盖范围提供了实用路径。

Authors: Jingxuan Zhu, Jingyi Li, LiangLiang Chen, Zhiyuan Jing, Jidong Zhang, Hongming Li

TANGO: Humanoid Navigation in Cluttered Environments with a Whole-Body Vision-Language-Action Model HumanoidEmbodied

whole-body vision-language navigation humanoid robot 29-DoF joint-space actions language-conditioned policy zero-shot deployment

简要说明：TANGO 是首个用于人形机器人的全身视觉-语言导航框架，通过 VLA 模型直接从语言指令和第一人称视觉预测 29 自由度动作，在仿真中训练并零样本部署于真实人形机器人。

TLDR: TANGO is the first whole-body vision-language navigation framework for humanoid robots, using a VLA model to directly predict 29-DoF actions from language and egocentric vision, trained in simulation and deployed zero-shot on a real humanoid.

Abstract: We study the problem of navigating cluttered indoor environments with a humanoid robot. Unlike conventional methods that model navigation as a 2D path planning problem, humanoid traversal in cluttered environments requires continuous geometry-aware whole-body adaptation, including coordinated arm placement, torso adjustment, and gait modulation for collision-free movement through complex 3D spaces. We introduce TANGO, the first whole-body vision-language navigation framework for language-conditioned humanoid traversal in cluttered environments. Given a natural-language instruction and egocentric RGB observations, TANGO directly predicts 29-DoF joint-space actions for downstream whole-body control. We train TANGO entirely in simulation by synthesizing diverse collision-free traversal behaviors via global path planning, kinematic whole-body motion generation, obstacle-aware motion editing, and RL-based tracking. This pipeline provides dynamically feasible action supervision for learning language-conditioned whole-body policies. In extensive simulation experiments, TANGO demonstrates state-of-the-art performance in vision-language navigation, while outperforming strong modular baselines in navigating challenging scenes requiring obstacle negotiation. Lastly, we deploy TANGO zero-shot on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, and observe robust language-guided traversal in cluttered real-world scenes without training on any real-world navigation data.

摘要（中文）：我们研究了人形机器人在杂乱室内环境中的导航问题。与将导航建模为二维路径规划问题的传统方法不同，人形机器人在杂乱环境中的行进需要持续的几何感知全身适应，包括协调的手臂放置、躯干调整以及步态调节，以在复杂三维空间中实现无碰撞移动。我们提出了TANGO，这是首个用于在杂乱环境中实现语言条件化人形机器人行进的全身视觉-语言导航框架。基于自然语言指令和以自我为中心的RGB观测，TANGO可直接预测29自由度关节空间动作，用于下游全身控制。我们完全在仿真环境中训练TANGO，通过全局路径规划、运动学全身运动生成、障碍物感知运动编辑以及基于强化学习的跟踪，合成多样化的无碰撞行进行为。该流程为学习语言条件化的全身策略提供了动态可行的动作监督。在大量仿真实验中，TANGO在视觉-语言导航中展现了最先进的性能，同时在对需要障碍协商的挑战性场景进行导航时，超越了强大的模块化基线方法。最后，我们将TANGO零样本部署至宇树G1人形机器人，观察到在未使用任何真实世界导航数据训练的情况下，该机器人在杂乱真实场景中实现了稳健的语言引导行进。

Authors: Anqi Li, Yuxin Chen, Zhaobo Li, Zhuo Cao, Junli Ren, Masayoshi Tomizuka, Dhruv Shah

DeCAL: Towards Physically-Grounded Dexterous Vision-Language-Action Models via Contact-Aware Latent Co-Imagination VLA

dexterous manipulation vision-language-action model tactile sensing Mixture-of-Transformers contact-aware gating

简要说明：DeCAL 提出了一种灵巧的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过自适应视觉-触觉融合和潜在共想象技术，提升了在遮挡和复杂接触动力学下的操作能力。

TLDR: DeCAL introduces a dexterous VLA model with adaptive visuo-tactile fusion and latent co-imagination to improve manipulation under occlusion and contact-rich dynamics.

Abstract: Dexterous manipulation involves contact-rich and fine-grained interactions with the physical world, posing significant challenges for existing vision-language-action (VLA) models due to severe visual occlusions and complex contact dynamics. While recent works have incorporated tactile sensing into robotic manipulation, most approaches still rely on homogeneous multimodal fusion, lacking adaptive tactile integration and explicit modeling of physical dynamics. In this work, we present DeCAL, a physically-grounded dexterous vision-language-action model that unifies understanding, imagination and action generation for contact-rich dexterous manipulation. Built upon a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture, DeCAL leverages specialized experts for each capability while enabling efficient information flow among them. To effectively leverage tactile information, we introduce Adaptive Visuo-Tactile Fusion that dynamically regulates tactile interactions via a contact-aware gating strategy. Furthermore, we propose Visuo-Tactile Latent Co-Imagination to jointly model visual and tactile dynamics, equipping the policy with implicit physical world knowledge. Experimental results show that DeCAL consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance across all tasks, attaining a 71% average success rate and an 83.4% progress success rate, while also demonstrating strong generalization to unseen scenarios. The website is available at https://aureleopku.github.io/DeCAL.

摘要（中文）：灵巧操作涉及与物理世界的高接触、细粒度交互，由于严重的视觉遮挡和复杂的接触动力学，这对现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型构成了重大挑战。尽管近期研究已将触觉感知引入机器人操作，但大多数方法仍依赖同质化的多模态融合，缺乏自适应的触觉集成和对物理动力学的显式建模。本文提出DeCAL，一种基于物理感知的灵巧视觉-语言-动作模型，它将理解、想象与动作生成统一于高接触灵巧操作任务中。该模型基于混合变换器（MoT）架构，为每种能力设置专用专家模块，同时保持专家间的高效信息流通。为有效利用触觉信息，我们引入自适应视觉-触觉融合机制，通过接触感知门控策略动态调节触觉交互。此外，我们提出视觉-触觉潜在联合想象模块，共同建模视觉与触觉动力学，使策略具备隐式物理世界知识。实验结果表明，DeCAL在所有任务中均持续取得最先进性能，平均成功率达71%，进度成功率达83.4%，并展现出对未见场景的强泛化能力。项目网站见 https://aureleopku.github.io/DeCAL。

Authors: Yankai Fu, Ning Chen, Junkai Zhao, Heng Zhang, Guocai Yao, Pengwei Wang, Zhongyuan Wang, Shanghang Zhang

PlannerForge: LLM Agents for Scenario-Based Testing of Motion Planners in Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

scenario-based testing LLM agents autonomous driving motion planner benchmarking

简要说明：PlannerForge 提出了一个统一的 LLM 智能体框架，覆盖自动驾驶场景测试的完整流程（从场景生成到系统评估），并使用现成的大语言模型在多个模块上取得了优异性能。

TLDR: PlannerForge introduces a unified LLM-agent framework that covers the entire scenario-based testing pipeline for autonomous driving, from scenario generation to ADS benchmarking, and demonstrates strong performance across multiple modules with off-the-shelf LLMs.

Abstract: Ensuring the safety of autonomous driving is a critical challenge. Scenario-based testing is a systematic process used to validate Autonomous Driving Systems (ADSs), but it remains a fragmented modular pipeline in which scenario generation, retrieval, modification, ADS execution, and results analysis are performed by separate tools with little interaction. Large Language Model (LLM) agents have shown promise across ADS sub-systems such as perception, planning, and control. However, no prior work covers the whole scenario-based testing pipeline for ADSs with a unified LLM-agent framework. We present PlannerForge, an LLM-agent framework that extends all scenario-based testing stages (from Scenario Generation to ADS Assessment) and adds two further LLM-enhanced stages: ADS Enhancement and ADS Benchmarking. We evaluate PlannerForge with 10 off-the-shelf LLMs across all tasks (Generation, Selection, Modification, Module Routing, Planner Testing, and Enhancement) under 5 prompt conditions. Best-per-task scores range from 0.88 to 1.00, and open-source 20-35B backends match commercial APIs on most tasks. Open-source models such as Qwen3.6:35B match commercial APIs on three of the five tasks. Chaining the modules end-to-end retains 83% / 78% of seed queries (commercial / open). It outperforms Scenario Factory 2.0 (Finkeldei et al., 2025) on natural-language generation (193 vs. 144 executable of 200) and realises 92-96% of requested city, road and vehicle attributes. It outperforms BM25 (Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009) at rank 1 selection (92.0% vs. 67.5%) and From-Words-to-Collisions (Gao et al., 2025) on physically valid edits (>=94% vs. 31%). At N=400, cost-tuning lifts planner success from 50.4% to 70.2% and cuts collisions from 19.0% to 8.4%, without domain-specific fine-tuning.

摘要（中文）：确保自动驾驶的安全性是一项关键挑战。基于场景的测试是验证自动驾驶系统（ADS）的系统化流程，但目前仍是一个碎片化的模块化流水线，其中场景生成、检索、修改、ADS执行及结果分析由彼此交互甚少的独立工具完成。大语言模型（LLM）智能体已在ADS的感知、规划与控制等子系统中展现出潜力，但尚无先前工作通过统一的大语言模型智能体框架覆盖完整的基于场景的测试流程。我们提出PlannerForge——一个扩展了所有基于场景的测试阶段（从场景生成到ADS评估）的大语言模型智能体框架，并新增两个由大语言模型增强的环节：ADS增强与ADS基准测试。我们在5种提示条件下，使用10个现成的大语言模型对所有任务（生成、筛选、修改、模块路由、规划器测试与增强）进行评估。各任务最佳得分为0.88至1.00，且开源20B-35B参数模型在大部分任务上可与商业API匹配。开源模型如Qwen3.6:35B在五项任务中的三项上达到商业API水平。将各模块端到端串联后，种子查询保留率为83%（商业模型）与78%（开源模型）。在自然语言生成方面，其性能超越Scenario Factory 2.0（Finkeldei等，2025）（200个可执行场景中生成193个 vs. 144个），并实现92%-96%的指定城市、道路与车辆属性。在首位筛选准确率上，其超越BM25（Robertson与Zaragoza，2009）（92.0% vs. 67.5%）；在物理有效编辑方面，其超越From-Words-to-Collisions（Gao等，2025）（≥94% vs. 31%）。当样本量N=400时，成本调优将规划器成功率从50.4%提升至70.2%，碰撞率从19.0%降至8.4%，且无需领域特定微调。

Authors: Yuan Gao, Sebastian Müller, Mattia Piccinini, Marc Kaufeld, Yuchen Zhang, Finn Rasmus Schäfer, Qunying Song, Johannes Betz

Model Predictive Control of Tensegrity Robots via Contact-Aware Graph Neural Dynamics Model Locomotion

tensegrity robot model predictive path integral (MPPI) graph neural network (GNN) contact-aware dynamics navigation

简要说明：一种接触感知的图神经网络动力学模型使MPPI控制器能够实现张拉整体机器人在复杂接触环境中的鲁棒导航。

TLDR: A contact-aware GNN dynamics model enables MPPI control for tensegrity robots, achieving robust navigation in contact-rich environments.

Abstract: Tensegrity robots offer lightweight, compliant mobility over challenging terrain but remain difficult to model and control due to complex contact-rich dynamics and partial observability. This work presents a model predictive path integral (MPPI) controller for a three-bar tensegrity robot driven by a learned graph neural network (GNN) dynamics model. This work first extends prior GNN-based models with a differentiable contact detection module. The extension allows the dynamics model to reason over non-horizontal planar terrains, obstacles, as well as self-collisions. Then, the learned dynamics model and the MPPI controller operate in a closed data-collection loop, iteratively improving model accuracy and control performance. This work further introduces a hybrid MPPI strategy that combines MPPI with turning motion primitives to improve maneuverability. Experiments are performed in MuJoCo across five navigation tasks, which include, wall obstacles, inclines, narrow corridors, low-clearance structures, and a composite 3D obstacle course. The experiments demonstrate that the hybrid MPPI controller operating over the learned GNN dynamics model improves predictive accuracy over a flat-ground baseline model and achieves superior navigation performance compared to $A^*$-based re-planning and MPPI-only variants. Results show that the contact-aware learned dynamics combined with the sampling-based model predictive control enable robust tensegrity navigation in complex, contact-rich environments.

摘要（中文）：张力整体机器人具有轻量化、高顺应性的特点，能够在复杂地形上实现机动，但由于其复杂的接触动力学和部分可观测性，建模与控制仍然困难。本文针对一种三杆张力整体机器人，提出了一种基于学习型图神经网络动力学模型的模型预测路径积分控制器。首先，通过引入可微分的接触检测模块，扩展了先前基于图神经网络的模型。该扩展使动力学模型能够处理非水平平面地形、障碍物以及自碰撞。随后，学习型动力学模型与模型预测路径积分控制器在闭环数据采集循环中运行，迭代提升模型精度与控制性能。本文进一步提出了一种混合模型预测路径积分策略，将模型预测路径积分与转向运动基元相结合，以提高机动性。在MuJoCo平台上开展了五项导航任务的实验，包括墙壁障碍、斜坡、狭窄通道、低净空结构以及复合三维障碍赛道。实验表明，基于学习型图神经网络动力学模型的混合模型预测路径积分控制器，相较于平面地形基线模型提升了预测精度，并且与基于A*的重规划方法及纯模型预测路径积分变体相比，实现了更优的导航性能。结果表明，结合接触感知学习型动力学与基于采样的模型预测控制，可使张力整体机器人在复杂、富含接触的环境中实现鲁棒导航。

Authors: Nelson Chen, Patrick Meng, Charles Tang, Angelina Degay, Zachary Brei, Rebecca Kramer-Bottiglio, Kostas E. Bekris, Mridul Aanjaneya

Ostrich: Taking Large Strides Through Stiff Contact in Differentiable Dynamics RLRobot

differentiable simulator rigid-body dynamics implicit function theorem gradient-based optimization contact-rich manipulation

简要说明：Ostrich 是一个 GPU 加速的刚体模拟器，通过非光滑牛顿迭代在大时间步长下处理硬接触，并利用隐函数定理进行微分，实现了每时间步 O(1) 的内存开销和在机器人轨迹优化中的高梯度可靠性。

TLDR: Ostrich is a GPU-accelerated rigid-body simulator that resolves hard contacts with non-smooth Newton iteration at large timesteps and differentiates via the implicit function theorem, achieving O(1) memory per timestep and high gradient reliability for trajectory optimization in robotics.

Abstract: Three properties determine whether a differentiable simulator can drive gradient-based optimization through contact: simulation accuracy, gradient reliability, and per-iteration cost. Tape-based engines such as MJX and Newton Semi-Implicit require timesteps small enough to keep contacts numerically tractable, and their backpropagation memory grows linearly with the number of timesteps T. Surrogate models bound memory by approximating contact away, but the resulting gradients lose the geometry the optimization depends on. We present Ostrich, a GPU-accelerated rigid-body simulator that resolves hard contacts and friction with non-smooth Newton iteration at large timesteps (h ~ 0.1 s), and differentiates the converged residual via the implicit function theorem, reusing the forward Schur complement to compute the adjoint at O(1) memory per timestep. On real-robot trajectories over a pallet obstacle, Ostrich holds MuJoCo's sim-to-real accuracy up to a 50x larger timestep. Its gradients converge from random initializations where MJX descends slowly and Newton Semi-Implicit stalls; a warm iteration runs 211x faster than MJX's and 4.7x faster than Semi-Implicit's. On the same scene Ostrich differentiates 8,192 parallel worlds on a single 24 GB GPU, sustaining 29x checkpointed MJX's optimization throughput; without checkpointing both baselines exhaust memory at far fewer worlds. We close with a gradient-based trajectory optimization demonstration over triangle-mesh terrain across a 10 s horizon, a setting where prior engines either restrict to primitive geometry or face the convergence and memory limits shown above.

摘要（中文）：三个关键属性决定了可微分仿真器能否通过接触驱动基于梯度的优化：仿真精度、梯度可靠性以及每次迭代的计算成本。基于磁带追踪的引擎（如MJX和Newton Semi-Implicit）要求时间步长足够小，以使接触在数值上可处理，且其反向传播内存随时间步数T线性增长。替代模型通过近似接触来限制内存使用，但由此产生的梯度会丢失优化所依赖的几何信息。我们提出Ostrich——一种GPU加速的刚体仿真器，它在大时间步长（h~0.1秒）下通过非光滑牛顿迭代求解硬接触与摩擦问题，并利用隐函数定理对收敛残差进行微分，通过复用前向舒尔补以每个时间步长O(1)的内存开销计算伴随矩阵。在跨越托盘障碍物的真实机器人轨迹上，Ostrich在高达50倍更大的时间步长下仍能保持MuJoCo的仿真到真实精度。其梯度能从随机初始状态收敛，而MJX下降缓慢、Newton Semi-Implicit停滞不前；一次热启动迭代速度比MJX快211倍，比Semi-Implicit快4.7倍。在同一场景中，Ostrich在单块24 GB GPU上对8192个并行世界进行微分，持续输出29倍于检查点型MJX的优化吞吐量；未使用检查点技术时，两种基线方法均在远少于该数量的世界下耗尽内存。最后，我们展示了在三角形网格地形上跨越10秒时域的基于梯度的轨迹优化示例，在此场景中，先前引擎要么局限于基本几何体，要么面临上述收敛性及内存限制。

Authors: Aleš Kučera, Karel Zimmermann

FOCI Policy: Focus on Object-Centric Interactions for Relational Manipulation Policies Manipulation

object-centric manipulation interaction-centric framework relative SE(3) motion rigid relational manipulation efficient learning

简要说明：FOCI Policy 提出了一种以交互为中心的框架，通过时间上提取紧凑交互片段和空间上使用物体间相对 SE(3) 运动来简化刚性关系操作，在更少训练数据下实现了强性能。

TLDR: FOCI Policy introduces an interaction-centric framework that simplifies rigid relational manipulation by abstracting temporally into compact interaction segments and spatially into relative SE(3) motion between objects, achieving strong performance with less training data.

Abstract: Object-centric manipulation policies improve generalization by modeling object motion instead of directly predicting robot actions. However, existing methods are often limited by representations which are either too simplistic to capture interaction dynamics or too dense to learn efficiently. We observe that many rigid relational manipulation tasks are governed by short interaction phases where the relative motion between task-relevant objects is tightly constrained. Based on this observation, we propose \textsc{Foci Policy}, an interaction-centric framework that achieves a two-fold abstraction: (1) temporally, by automatically extracting compact interaction segments from demonstrations;(2) spatially, by representing skills as relative $SE(3)$ motion between task-relevant objects, yielding invariance to scene configurations and robot embodiment. Experiments on RLBench, COLOSSEUM, and real-world tasks show that \textsc{Foci Policy} achieves strong performance with substantially less training data than prior object-centric and action-centric policies. These results suggest that modeling object-object interactions provides a simple and efficient inductive bias for rigid relational manipulation. Project page: \href{https://fitz0401.github.io/foci-page/}{fitz0401.github.io/foci-page/}.

摘要（中文）：以物体为中心的操作策略通过建模物体运动而非直接预测机器人动作来提升泛化能力。然而，现有方法常受限于表征方式——要么过于简单而无法捕捉交互动态，要么过于稠密而难以高效学习。我们观察到许多刚性关系操作任务受控于短暂的交互阶段，在此阶段中任务相关物体间的相对运动受到严格约束。基于这一观察，我们提出\textsc{Foci Policy}框架，该框架以交互为中心实现双重抽象：（1）时间维度上，通过从演示中自动提取紧凑的交互片段；（2）空间维度上，通过将技能表示为任务相关物体间的相对$SE(3)$运动，从而获得对场景配置与机器人形态的不变性。在RLBench、COLOSSEUM及真实世界任务上的实验表明，相较于先前的以物体为中心和以动作为中心的策略，\textsc{Foci Policy}能以显著更少的训练数据实现强劲性能。这些结果表明，对物体间交互的建模为刚性关系操作提供了简单高效的归纳偏置。项目页面：\href{https://fitz0401.github.io/foci-page/}{fitz0401.github.io/foci-page/}。

Authors: Ze Fu, Pinhao Song, Yutong Hu, Renaud Detry

Learning to build covering structures with continuous adjustments Manipulation

reinforcement learning robotic construction graph neural networks soft actor-critic sim-to-real transfer

简要说明：本文提出了一种自适应机器人建造的强化学习方法，利用图结构状态表示和混合动作空间，训练出能够从仿真迁移到真实硬件的策略，成功建造了跨拱结构。

TLDR: This paper presents a reinforcement learning approach for adaptive robotic construction that uses graph-structured state representations and a mixed action space, training policies that transfer from simulation to real hardware for building a spanning arch.

Abstract: Robotic construction offers the potential to use materials more efficiently and create complex geometries, but current methods rely on rigid, high-precision plans that cannot accommodate the tolerances, inaccuracies, and unexpected changes inherent in physical fabrication. In this work, we introduce a reinforcement learning approach that forgoes predefined plans entirely, instead generating construction sequences adaptively as the structure is built. Our method operates on graph-structured state representations and a mixed (parameterized) action space, requiring both discrete block selection and continuous placement parameters. Because the stability simulation of a structure is computationally heavy, we develop an efficient exploration strategy by incorporating unilateral edges into graph neural networks, extending soft actor-critic (SAC) to this hybrid setting. We evaluate our algorithm, HSAC, against the prior method hybrid-PPO (HPPO), demonstrating significantly higher asymptotic performance and good sample efficiency. We also demonstrate HSAC's robustness to hyperparameter choices and its exploration capability, handling up to 10 discrete actions without performance degradation. Finally, we validate our approach on a physical two-robot setup, successfully building a spanning arch with 3D-printed blocks in closed-loop execution, confirming that policies trained in simulation transfer to real hardware.

摘要（中文）：机器人建造技术有望提高材料利用效率并实现复杂几何结构，但现有方法依赖于刚性、高精度的规划方案，无法适应物理建造中固有的公差、误差及意外变化。本研究提出一种强化学习方法，完全摒弃预定义规划方案，转而根据结构建造过程自适应生成施工序列。该方法基于图结构状态表征与混合（参数化）动作空间运行，需同时处理离散块体选择与连续放置参数。鉴于结构稳定性模拟计算量较大，我们通过将单侧边纳入图神经网络，并将软演员-评论家算法（SAC）扩展至该混合场景，开发出高效探索策略。我们将所提出的HSAC算法与先前的混合PPO方法（HPPO）进行对比，验证了其显著更高的渐近性能与良好的样本效率。同时证明HSAC对超参数选择具有鲁棒性，且其探索能力可处理多达10个离散动作而性能不降。最终，我们在双机器人物理平台上进行验证，通过闭环执行成功使用3D打印块体构建了悬跨拱结构，确认了模拟训练策略可迁移至实际硬件。

Authors: Gabriel Vallat, Maryam Kamgarpour, Stefana Parascho

PGMT: Perceptive General Motion Tracking for Humanoid Robots HumanoidEmbodied

humanoid motion tracking terrain adaptation perceptive locomotion whole-body control zero-shot deployment

简要说明：PGMT学习了一种统一策略，将地形感知与运动跟踪相结合，使人形机器人能够在复杂真实地形上实现地形自适应运动与全身动作执行。

TLDR: PGMT learns a unified policy that integrates terrain perception with motion tracking for humanoid robots, enabling terrain-adaptive locomotion and whole-body motion execution on complex real-world terrain.

Abstract: Humanoid motion trackers can reproduce diverse whole-body motions, but their performance degrades on complex terrain where terrain-agnostic references become physically infeasible. We present PGMT, a Perceptive General Motion Tracking pipeline for humanoid robots that learns terrain adaptation from independently selected motion references and terrains. PGMT first learns a general tracking and recovery prior, then incorporates terrain perception through motion-conditioned terrain glimpses that selectively encode regions relevant to the current motion. Terrain-aware tracking relaxation allows necessary deviations from the reference while preserving its motion intent. Zero-shot deployment on a Unitree G1 demonstrates robust terrain-adaptive locomotion and whole-body motion execution over real-world terrain with obstacles up to 37 cm high, while supporting teleoperation, dynamic motion tracking, and fall recovery. PGMT extends general humanoid motion tracking beyond flat ground, providing a unified policy for terrain-adaptive locomotion, diverse whole-body behaviors, and teleoperation in complex environments. Project homepage: https://luyili.github.io/pgmt/

摘要（中文）：类人运动追踪器能够再现多样化的全身运动，但在复杂地形上，由于与地形无关的参考动作在物理上变得不可行，其性能会显著下降。我们提出PGMT——一种基于感知的通用运动追踪框架，使类人机器人能够从独立选择的运动参考和地形中学习地形适应能力。PGMT首先学习通用的追踪与恢复先验知识，随后通过运动条件化地形快照融入地形感知能力，该机制选择性地编码与当前运动相关的区域。基于地形的追踪松弛策略允许在保留运动意图的前提下对参考动作进行必要偏离。在Unitree G1机器人上的零样本部署表明，该框架能够在包含高达37厘米障碍物的真实地形上实现稳健的地形适应运动与全身动作执行，同时支持远程操控、动态运动追踪及跌倒恢复。PGMT将通用类人运动追踪从平坦地面扩展到复杂地形，为地形适应运动、多样化全身行为以及复杂环境中的远程操控提供了统一策略。项目主页：https://luyili.github.io/pgmt/

Authors: Hongyi Li, Li Peizhuo, Yucheng Tao, Ze Wang, Fangzhou Xu, Jinyi Chen, Yanyan Yuan, Dapeng Jia, Yongbin Jin, Mingfeng Fan, Guillaume Sartoretti, Hongtao Wang

AirAnchor: Bridging Local and Global Spatial Information for Zero-Shot Aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation VLN

Aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation zero-shot spatial anchors persistent object spatial memory spatially-informed navigation agent

简要说明：AirAnchor 提出一种零样本空中导航框架，通过空间锚点和持久对象记忆桥接局部与全局空间信息，在 AerialVLN 上显著超越现有基线。

TLDR: AirAnchor proposes a zero-shot aerial navigation framework that bridges local and global spatial information via spatial anchors and persistent object memory, significantly outperforming existing baselines on AerialVLN.

Abstract: Aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation requires drones to follow natural-language instructions and navigate through complex urban environments. Accurate navigation relies on both local and global spatial information, which support immediate action grounding and long-horizon path planning, respectively. However, existing zero-shot methods typically operate at a single spatial scale, relying either on local representations constructed online from current observations or on global memories built offline from historical experience. To address this limitation, we propose AirAnchor, a new paradigm that bridges local and global spatial information through spatial anchors and integrates both into a shared navigation framework, enabling comprehensive spatial grounding for decision-making. AirAnchor consists of three core components: (1) Query-Driven Spatial Anchor Grounding, which identifies decision-relevant anchors from visual observations and organizes them into local spatial representations; (2) Persistent Object Spatial Memory, which incrementally maintains an object knowledge base as persistent global spatial memory and retrieves landmark-related spatial priors; and (3) a Spatially-Informed Navigation Agent, which explicitly integrates both local and global spatial information into an agentic framework for decision-making. Extensive experiments on AerialVLN demonstrate that AirAnchor substantially outperforms existing zero-shot baselines, validating the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed paradigm.

摘要（中文）：航空视觉与语言导航要求无人机遵循自然语言指令，在复杂的城市环境中完成导航任务。精确导航依赖局部与全局空间信息，分别支撑即时动作定位与长程路径规划。然而，现有零样本方法通常仅在单一空间尺度上运作，或依赖基于当前观测在线构建的局部表征，或依赖基于历史经验离线建立的全局记忆。为解决这一局限，我们提出AirAnchor——一种通过空间锚点桥接局部与全局空间信息的新范式，并将两者整合至统一导航框架中，实现决策的全面空间定位。AirAnchor包含三个核心组件：(1) 查询驱动的空间锚点定位模块，从视觉观测中识别与决策相关的锚点，并将其组织为局部空间表征；(2) 持久化物体空间记忆模块，以增量方式维护物体知识库作为持久全局空间记忆，并检索与地标相关的空间先验；(3) 空间感知导航智能体，将局部与全局空间信息显式整合至智能体决策框架中。在AerialVLN上的大量实验表明，AirAnchor显著优于现有零样本基线方法，验证了所提范式的有效性与高效性。

Authors: Shanwei Fan, Bin Zhang, Zhiwei Xu, Yingxuan Teng, Siqi Dai, Lin Cheng, Guoliang Fan

3DWay: Generalizing Robot Manipulation via 3D Consistent Waypoints VLA

3D waypoints multi-view triangulation robot manipulation vision-language-action generalization

简要说明：本文提出通过从多视图图像中三角化2D路点来预测3D一致路点，从而增强机器人操作策略的3D空间理解与泛化能力。

TLDR: The paper proposes predicting 3D-consistent waypoints from multi-view images by triangulating 2D waypoints, enabling better 3D spatial grounding and generalization for robot manipulation policies.

Abstract: Intermediate representations are key to bridging the modality gap between generalizable manipulation policies and large-scale pretrained vision-language models (VLMs). Among these, trajectory-based representations compactly represent motion-relevant cues, yet most existing approaches predict trajectories in 2D image space, resulting in intrinsic 3D ambiguity. Moreover, using 2D trajectories with depth still leaves the free-space waypoints ambiguous, limiting reliable 3D reasoning. To address this, we propose predicting 3D consistent waypoints (3DWay) from multi-view images. By reformulating 3D waypoints prediction as generating multi-view consistent 2D waypoints followed by geometric triangulation, we enable explicit 3D motion specification while preserving the strong priors of pretrained VLMs. The predicted waypoints can guide existing VLA models for better generalization or be directly executed on simple tasks. Extensive experiments show that 3DWay substantially improves 3D spatial grounding and vision-language reasoning, demonstrating strong potential for generalizable robot manipulation. Codes will be released at https://github.com/ziqin-h/3DWay.

摘要（中文）：中间表示是弥合通用操控策略与大规模预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）之间模态差异的关键。其中，基于轨迹的表示能够紧凑地编码运动相关线索，然而现有方法大多在二维图像空间中预测轨迹，这导致固有的三维歧义性。此外，使用带有深度信息的二维轨迹仍会使自由空间路径点不明确，从而限制了可靠的三维推理。为解决这一问题，我们提出从多视角图像中预测三维一致的路径点（3DWay）。通过将三维路径点预测重构为生成多视角一致的二维路径点，并随后进行几何三角化，我们能够在保留预训练VLM强大先验的同时实现显式的三维运动指定。所预测的路径点既可引导现有VLA模型实现更好的泛化，也可直接用于执行简单任务。大量实验表明，3DWay显著提升了三维空间定位与视觉语言推理能力，展现出在通用机器人操控中的巨大潜力。代码将发布于https://github.com/ziqin-h/3DWay。

Authors: Ziqin Huang, Yingyue Li, Chenyangguang Zhang, Ruida Zhang, Yuxin Chen, Gu Wang, Xingyu Liu, Masayoshi Tomizuka, Xiangyang Ji

Drive by Hindsight and Foresight: Tool-Grounded Synergistic Reasoning over Hierarchical Memory for Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

hierarchical driving memory memory-tool synergistic reasoning proactive tool invocation spatio-temporal understanding continual self-evolution

简要说明：提出一种结合层次化记忆（短期记忆维护场景状态，长期记忆积累经验）与主动工具调用的闭环推理框架，用于VLM自动驾驶，在DriveLMM-o1及泛化基准上取得领先性能。

TLDR: Proposes a VLM-based autonomous driving framework combining hierarchical memory (short-term for scene state, long-term for experience) with proactive tool invocation in a closed reasoning loop, achieving strong results on DriveLMM-o1 and generalization benchmarks.

Abstract: VLMs have shown promise for autonomous driving, yet still suffer from hallucination, weak spatio-temporal perception, and limited generalization. Recent methods improve reasoning and decision-making through CoT explanations, retrieval-augmented generation or the static injection of tool outputs. Although these mechanisms enrich the context, the model neither proactively perceives scene information nor accumulates experience after answering. To overcome these limitations, we present, to our knowledge, the first synergistic framework that tightly couples hierarchical memory with proactive tool invocation in a closed reasoning loop. Our contributions are threefold. (i) Hierarchical Driving Memory: a scene-level short-term memory maintains the dynamic scene state, and an evolving long-term memory retrieves reusable experience and tool strategies. (ii) Memory-Tool Synergistic Reasoning Framework: guided by the scene state and retrieved experience, the model adaptively invokes tools to refine its reasoning at inference time and consolidates reusable experience into a long-term memory pool offline. (iii) Data Generation and Two-stage Training Pipeline: verified memory-tool trajectories built by multi-step teacher rollout are used to train with SFT and GRPO. Our 7B model reaches an overall reasoning score of 80.03 and MCQ accuracy of 79.09% on DriveLMM-o1, surpassing the strongest baseline by 7.74 MCQ points and generalizes strongly across benchmarks. Notably, ablation and analysis studies validate the effectiveness of each component and further reveal the complementary roles of hierarchical memory. Short-term memory strengthens spatio-temporal understanding, improving STSBench accuracy by 24.2 points, while offline long-term memory consolidation yields an additional 3.57-point MCQ gain with all parameters frozen, demonstrating continual self-evolution through accumulated driving experience.

摘要（中文）：VLMs在自动驾驶领域展现出潜力，但仍存在幻觉、时空感知薄弱及泛化能力有限等问题。现有方法通过思维链解释、检索增强生成或静态注入工具输出来改进推理与决策。尽管这些机制丰富了上下文信息，但模型既无法主动感知场景信息，也无法在作答后积累经验。为克服这些局限，我们提出了据我们所知首个将分层记忆与主动工具调用紧密耦合于闭环推理回路的协同框架。本文贡献有三：(i) 分层驾驶记忆：场景级短期记忆维护动态场景状态，进化型长期记忆检索可复用经验与工具策略；(ii) 记忆-工具协同推理框架：在场景状态与检索经验的引导下，模型在推理阶段自适应调用工具优化推理过程，并在离线状态下将可复用经验整合至长期记忆池；(iii) 数据生成与两阶段训练流程：利用多步教师展开构建经验证的记忆-工具轨迹，通过监督式微调与分组相对策略优化进行训练。我们的7B模型在DriveLMM-o1上取得80.03总体推理分数与79.09%多选题准确率，以7.74个多选题百分点优势超越最强基线，并在多个基准测试中展现强泛化能力。消融与分析研究验证了各组件的有效性，并进一步揭示了分层记忆的互补作用：短期记忆增强时空理解，使STSBench准确率提升24.2个百分点；而所有参数冻结下离线长期记忆整合额外带来3.57个多选题百分点增益，证明了通过积累驾驶经验实现的持续自我进化。

Authors: Baojie Chen, Zijun Jia, Jing Zhong

Monkey See, Can Monkey Do? A Benchmark for Evaluating Robot Skill Learning by Observation Manipulation

Learning from Observation benchmark manipulation tasks human videos VLA

简要说明：提出了RoboReel，一个用于评估从人类演示视频中学习机器人技能的基准，涵盖十个操作任务和七种最先进的算法。

TLDR: Introduces RoboReel, a benchmark for evaluating robot skill learning from human demonstration videos, covering ten manipulation tasks and seven state-of-the-art algorithms.

Abstract: Learning from Observation (LfO) is a fundamental robotic capability that replicates how humans and animals socially learn from each other. Beyond its biological parallels, this modality provides a practical solution for data scaling in sample-inefficient and data-starved domains like robotics. Recent work has demonstrated promising results in learning manipulation skills from human videos, yet progress in this area remains difficult to assess. Existing methods vary widely in assumptions, hardware choices, and environment setups making it difficult to draw meaningful comparisons and identify advances in the field. To address these challenges, we introduce RoboReel: a unified benchmark for evaluating models that learn policies from human videos. RoboReel consists of bundled real-world human demonstration videos, simulated robot trajectories, and evaluation environments on ten manipulation tasks. We develop four test suites to evaluate the models' performance on multiple axes, including the robustness to visual distractors and the ability to complete long-horizon tasks. Our benchmark covers learning-from-observation models from different categories, and studies the effectiveness of multiple representation choices in our benchmark evaluation that covers over seven state-of-the-art algorithms (including our VLA based variants) in the field of LfO. Finally, we present an analysis of the different types of algorithms showing that long-horizon tasks and tasks with low tolerances are still challenging for current models. Webpage: https://roboreel.github.io

摘要（中文）：从观察中学习（LfO）是一种基本的机器人能力，它复制了人类和动物在社会环境中相互学习的方式。除了其生物学类比外，这种模式为机器人等样本效率低下且数据匮乏的领域提供了一种数据扩展的实用解决方案。近年来的研究在从人类视频中学习操作技能方面展示了令人鼓舞的成果，但该领域的进展仍难以评估。现有方法在假设条件、硬件选择和环境设置上差异较大，导致难以进行有意义的比较并识别领域内的进步。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了RoboReel：一个统一基准，用于评估从人类视频中学习策略的模型。RoboReel包含十个操作任务上配套的真实世界人类演示视频、模拟机器人轨迹及评估环境。我们开发了四个测试套件，从多个维度评估模型性能，包括对视觉干扰物的鲁棒性以及完成长时域任务的能力。该基准覆盖了不同类别的从观察中学习模型，并在涵盖LfO领域七种以上最先进算法（包括基于VLA的变体）的基准评估中研究了多种表征选择的有效性。最后，我们对不同类型的算法进行了分析，表明长时域任务和低容错任务对当前模型仍具挑战性。网页：https://roboreel.github.io

Authors: Weiwei Gu, Anmol Gupta, Anant Sah, Ryan Varghese, Lalitha Shreya Vanam, Prabhath Adireddi, Peter Karkus, Nakul Gopalan

OmniNav: Robust Long-Horizon Target Navigation in Dynamic Environments VLN

long-horizon navigation Bayesian belief revision object scene memory interaction feasibility partial observability

简要说明：OmniNav 提出了一种贝叶斯分解的任务状态后验模型，用于长时域导航，耦合场景有效性、目标信念和交互可行性，在真实世界中提升了抓取放置的成功率。

TLDR: OmniNav proposes a Bayesian factorized task-state posterior for long-horizon navigation that couples scene validity, target belief, and interaction feasibility, achieving robust real-world pick-and-place success.

Abstract: Long-horizon target navigation requires a robot to sustain task execution across evolving observations, decisions, and physical interactions. This requires three coupled capabilities: maintaining valid scene memory, revising target beliefs under partial observability, and selecting interaction-feasible navigation endpoints. However, the state underlying each capability is only conditionally valid: scene representations become stale when objects move or disappear, unsuccessful searches alter beliefs over target locations, and geometrically convenient endpoints may still be infeasible for manipulation. To address these challenges, we present OmniNav, which formulates long-horizon navigation as continual inference over a factorized task state posterior coupling scene validity, target belief, and interaction feasibility. For representation, OmniNav incrementally constructs an updatable 3D object scene memory, preventing stale scene evidence from propagating to subsequent decisions. For exploration, it introduces an evidence-aware Bayesian belief-revision mechanism that derives dependency-aware region priors from semantic context, incorporates unsuccessful searches as negative evidence, and updates them for posterior-guided frontier selection. For interaction, OmniNav incorporates manipulation reachability and collision constraints into navigation-endpoint selection and propagates execution feedback through hierarchical closed-loop recovery. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OmniNav achieves the highest success rates among the compared methods on semantic ObjectNav and fine-grained instance navigation benchmarks, remains robust to target relocation, and improves real-world pick-and-place success from 53.3% to 71.7% over an adapted open-loop baseline. The project page of OmniNav is available at https://omni-nav.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：长时域目标导航要求机器人在不断变化的观测、决策与物理交互过程中维持任务执行。这需要三种相互耦合的能力：维护有效的场景记忆、在部分可观测条件下修正目标信念，以及选择支持交互的导航终点。然而，每种能力所依赖的状态仅具有条件有效性：当物体移动或消失时场景表征会过时，未成功的搜索会改变目标位置的信念，而几何上适宜的终点可能仍不可用于操作。为应对这些挑战，我们提出OmniNav，将长时域导航形式化为对分解的任务状态后验（耦合场景有效性、目标信念与交互可行性）的持续推理。在表征方面，OmniNav增量构建可更新的三维物体场景记忆，防止过时的场景证据传播至后续决策。在探索方面，它引入基于证据的贝叶斯信念修正机制，从语义上下文中导出依赖感知的区域先验，将未成功的搜索视为负面证据并进行更新，以支持后验引导的前沿选择。在交互方面，OmniNav将操作可达性与碰撞约束纳入导航终点选择，并通过分层闭环恢复传播执行反馈。大量实验表明，OmniNav在语义物体导航与细粒度实例导航基准测试中相较对比方法取得最高成功率，对目标位置重排保持鲁棒性，并在真实场景拾取-放置任务中相较于改进的开环基线将成功率从53.3%提升至71.7%。OmniNav的项目页面访问地址为https://omni-nav.github.io/。

Authors: Yujie Tang, Meiling Wang, Jinhao Jiang, Sibo Zuo, Yinan Deng, Xinyu Zhang, Yufeng Yue

Observe Before You Alert: Adaptive Driver Alerting with Vision-Language Models AutonomousDriving

adaptive driver alerting vision-language model evidence-gathering policy dashcam alert dataset safety-evidence generator

简要说明：VLAlert提出了一种自适应驾驶员预警框架，利用视觉语言模型决定静默、观察或警报，在真实行车记录仪数据集上提升了检测效果和部署效用。

TLDR: VLAlert proposes an adaptive driver alerting framework that uses a VLM to decide whether to silently observe, gather evidence, or alert, achieving improved detection and deployment utility on real-world dashcam datasets.

Abstract: Driver alerting from dashcam video requires sequential decision-making under partial observability: a system must decide not only whether a scene is risky, but also when the evidence is sufficient to warn. Most existing accident anticipation models output a binary risk score, leaving ambiguous scenes to be handled by thresholding. We propose VLAlert, a vision-language alerting framework that casts warning generation as a tri-action policy over SILENT, OBSERVE, and ALERT. The OBSERVE action acts as an internal evidence-gathering decision that delays uncertain warnings and changes the next observation window, creating a lightweight perception-action loop for adaptive alerting. VLAlert uses Qwen3-VL-4B as a safety-evidence generator and pools hidden states from structured belief spans to form compact representations for danger estimation and policy prediction. We evaluate VLAlert on VLAlert-Bench, a unified per-tick benchmark from four real-world dashcam alert datasets, and further test transfer to held-out naturalistic ADAS takeover clips. On VLAlert-Bench validation, VLAlert achieves the highest deployment-oriented utility among tested baselines, with DAUS 0.4878 compared with 0.4752 for Open-BADAS, and improves AUROC, AP_tick, F1_t, and balanced accuracy from 0.610, 0.176, 0.276, and 0.581 to 0.689, 0.195, 0.297, and 0.648, respectively. On 221 held-out ADAS-TO-Critic clips, VLAlert improves R@5s from 74.2% to 88.7% and F1 from 0.585 to 0.686. These results indicate that adaptive observation and safety-focused VLM representations provide measurable gains for driver-facing alert decisions.

摘要（中文）：基于行车记录仪视频的驾驶员警报系统需要在部分可观测条件下进行序贯决策：系统不仅需要判断场景是否存在风险，还需决定何时收集到足够证据以发出警报。现有的大多数事故预测模型仅输出二值风险分数，对模糊场景的处理依赖于阈值设定。我们提出VLAlert——一个视觉-语言警报框架，将警报生成建模为包含静默、观测、警报三种动作的策略。其中观测动作作为内部证据收集决策，可延迟不确定的警报并改变下一观测窗口，由此构建轻量级感知-行动循环以实现自适应警报。VLAlert采用Qwen3-VL-4B作为安全证据生成器，通过汇聚结构化信念区间的隐藏状态形成紧凑表示，用于危险估计与策略预测。我们在VLAlert-Bench（基于四个真实行车记录仪警报数据集构建的统一逐帧基准）上评估VLAlert，并进一步测试其在自然驾驶ADAS接管片段（保留数据集）上的迁移性能。在VLAlert-Bench验证集上，VLAlert在所有测试基线中实现了最高的部署导向效用，DAUS达0.4878（对比Open-BADAS的0.4752），并将AUROC、AP_tick、F1_t和平衡准确率从0.610、0.176、0.276、0.581提升至0.689、0.195、0.297、0.648。在221段保留的ADAS-TO-Critic片段上，VLAlert将R@5s从74.2%提升至88.7%，F1从0.585提升至0.686。这些结果表明，自适应观测机制与面向安全的视觉语言模型表示为面向驾驶员的警报决策带来了可量化的性能提升。

Authors: Yuhang Wang, Lingyao Li, Hao Zhou

SPOT: Spatial Perception-Oriented Long-Horizon Humanoid Teleoperation HumanoidEmbodied

teleoperation humanoid robot perceptual horizon viewpoint decoupling data collection

简要说明：SPOT 是一种用于人形机器人的 VR 遥操作界面，通过提供宽视场、稳定且可主动检查的机器人视角，将视觉探索与机器人动作解耦，从而提升长程数据采集的效率和准确性。

TLDR: SPOT is a VR teleoperation system for humanoid robots that decouples visual exploration from robot actuation using a wide-field, stabilized, actively inspectable view, improving long-horizon data collection efficiency and accuracy.

Abstract: High-quality demonstration data is becoming a central bottleneck for training general-purpose humanoid robots. While recent humanoid teleoperation systems have made substantial progress in retargeting human motion to robot motion, long-horizon loco-manipulation requires another capability: operators must maintain task-relevant spatial awareness over time, e.g., object locations, surrounding environments, the robot's pose. We call the extent of this awareness the operator's perceptual horizon. However, existing methods often shorten this: narrow views miss peripheral events, robot-mounted cameras become unstable during locomotion, and coupled head-view control makes looking around interfere with robot motion. We present SPOT, a Spatial Perception-Oriented VR Teleoperation system for collecting long-horizon humanoid demonstration data by providing extended perceptual horizon. SPOT combines a robot-mounted binocular fisheye camera, a wide-field stereoscopic display, viewpoint-decoupled free-looking, and visual stabilization to provide a robot-centric view that is wide, stable, and actively inspectable. Unlike conventional egocentric interfaces, SPOT decouples visual exploration from robot actuation: the egocentric stereo observation is rendered on a virtual hemisphere around the operator, so natural head rotations change where the operator looks within the wide-field view rather than commanding the robot head, camera, or torso. We evaluate SPOT on perception-critical humanoid data-collection tasks spanning drop recovery, peripheral retrieval, large-workspace bimanual manipulation, fine alignment, and dynamic interaction. SPOT improves efficiency, accuracy, and recovery speed, demonstrating its effectiveness for user-friendly and scalable long-horizon humanoid data collection.

摘要（中文）：高质量示范数据正成为训练通用类人机器人的核心瓶颈。尽管近年来类人机器人遥操作系统在将人体运动重定向至机器人运动方面取得显著进展，但长时域移动操作需要另一项能力：操作员必须持续保持与任务相关的空间感知——例如物体位置、周围环境及机器人姿态。我们将这种感知的覆盖范围称为操作员的感知视域。然而，现有方法常会缩短这一视域：窄视场导致遗漏周边事件，机器人搭载的摄像机在运动时产生不稳定画面，而耦合的头部视角控制使环视动作干扰机器人运动。我们提出SPOT——一种面向空间感知的VR遥操作系统，通过扩展感知视域来采集长时域类人机器人示范数据。SPOT结合了机器人搭载的双目鱼眼摄像机、宽视场立体显示器、视点解耦自由环视及视觉稳定技术，提供以机器人为中心且兼具宽视场、稳定性与主动探索能力的视野。与传统以自我为中心的界面不同，SPOT将视觉探索与机器人驱动解耦：以自我为中心的立体观察画面渲染在操作员周围的虚拟半球面上，因此自然的头部转动仅改变操作员在宽视场中的观察位置，而非操控机器人头部、摄像机或躯干。我们在包含坠落恢复、周边抓取、大工作区双臂操作、精密对齐及动态交互等感知关键型类人数据采集任务中评估了SPOT。该系统提升了效率、精度及恢复速度，证明了其在实现用户友好且可扩展的长时域类人数据采集方面的有效性。

Authors: Lixing Fang, Ziyan Xiong, Sunli Chen, Zhiyang Dou, Chuang Gan

M3-Tele: A Unified Multimodal Teleoperational Framework for Compliant Whole-Body Mobile Manipulation Manipulation

multimodal teleoperation whole-body mobile manipulation compliant control tactile sensing force tracking

简要说明：M3-Tele是一个统一的 multimodal 遥操作框架，通过整合视觉、触觉、力觉和本体感知，提升了全身移动操作在接触式任务中的表现和数据收集质量。

TLDR: M3-Tele is a unified multimodal teleoperation framework for compliant whole-body mobile manipulation that integrates visual, tactile, force, and proprioceptive sensing to improve contact-rich task performance and demonstration quality.

Abstract: Executing contact-rich tasks efficiently requires the seamless integration of whole-body coordination and physical compliance regulation. However, existing teleoperation and data-collection frameworks often overlook the joint consideration of multimodal perception and coordinated whole-body operation. This limitation can reduce the efficiency and quality of demonstration collection, thereby affecting the effectiveness of downstream policy learning. In this work, we present \textbf{M3-Tele}: A Unified \underline{M}ultimodal \underline{Tele}operational Framework for Compliant Whole-Body \underline{M}obile \underline{M}anipulation, enabling stable physical interaction and capturing aligned visual, tactile, force, and proprioceptive observations during task execution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework significantly improves contact-rich teleoperation performance. The proposed controller reduces the force tracking error from 4.132~N to 0.346~N, the contact loss from 2.46 to 0.02 events per trial and the tactile deformation error by 65\%. User studies across four mobile manipulation tasks also verify the reliability and usability of the proposed system. Furthermore, Diffusion Policy experiments highlight the value of joint tactile and force sensing.

摘要（中文）：高效执行接触密集型任务需要全身协调与物理顺应性调控的无缝集成。然而，现有遥操作与数据采集框架往往忽略多模态感知与协调全身操作的联合考量。这一局限会降低示范采集的效率与质量，从而影响下游策略学习的效果。本文提出 **M3-Tele**：一种用于顺应性全身移动操作任务的统一多模态遥操作框架，该框架能够在任务执行过程中实现稳定的物理交互，并捕获对齐的视觉、触觉、力觉及本体感知观测数据。大量实验表明，所提框架显著提升了接触密集型遥操作性能。该控制器将力跟踪误差从4.132牛降至0.346牛，每次试验的接触丢失事件从2.46次降至0.02次，触觉变形误差降低65%。涵盖四项移动操作任务的用户研究也验证了所提系统的可靠性与易用性。此外，扩散策略实验进一步凸显了触觉与力觉联合感知的价值。

Authors: Hengxiang Chen, Shenwen Deng, Yujian Ma, Gan Ma, Qiang Li, Nutan Chen

ComVLA: Communication-Aware Split Inference for VLA Models in 6G-Connected Robotics VLA

vision-language-action split inference semantic communication token pruning 6G-connected robotics

简要说明：ComVLA提出了一种面向VLA模型的通信感知拆分推理框架，利用语言指导将令牌传输预算自适应到无线信道容量，在任务成功率小幅下降的情况下显著降低推理计算量和延迟。

TLDR: ComVLA proposes a communication-aware split inference framework for VLA models that uses language guidance to adapt the token transmission budget to wireless channel capacity, reducing inference compute and latency with minimal task success loss.

Abstract: Connected robotics is an emerging 6G application where mobile robots follow natural-language instructions to manipulate physical objects. The Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models that enable this are too large to run on the robot; a common trend is to offload inference to the cloud. The wireless link, however, limits how much sensing data the edge can transmit per control step. Two recent lines address this constraint: semantic communication codecs compress sensor data but require channel-specific retraining, and VLA token pruners select tokens from image but ignore the channel. Our insight is that the dense semantic information contained in the language already indicates which visual tokens matter. We propose ComVLA, a framework that uses this language guidance to adapt the VLA token budget to the channel capacity. Transmitting 32 tokens instead of 512 on the LIBERO benchmark, ComVLA cuts inference compute by 74% and inference latency by 22% versus the original OpenVLA-OFT baseline, at a cost of 1.5 pp in average task success (95.4% vs. 96.9%), and it stays within the capacity budget under Rayleigh and Rician fading. These results demonstrate that co-designing VLA inference and wireless communication is a practical direction for 6G-connected robotics.

摘要（中文）：连接机器人技术是一种新兴的6G应用，使移动机器人能够遵循自然语言指令来操控物理物体。实现这一功能的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型体积过大，无法在机器人上直接运行；因此，将推理任务卸载至云端已成为普遍趋势。然而，无线链路限制了边缘端在每个控制步骤中可传输的传感数据量。最近的两类研究针对这一约束提出了解决方案：语义通信编解码器可压缩传感器数据，但需要针对特定信道进行重新训练；而VLA令牌剪枝器则从图像中筛选令牌，却忽略了信道条件。我们的核心发现是：语言中包含的密集语义信息已能指示哪些视觉令牌具有相关性。为此，我们提出了ComVLA框架——该框架利用语言引导，根据信道容量动态调整VLA令牌预算。在LIBERO基准测试中，与原始OpenVLA-OFT基线相比，ComVLA仅需传输32个令牌（而非512个），便将推理计算量降低了74%，推理延迟减少了22%，而平均任务成功率仅下降1.5个百分点（95.4%对96.9%）；且在瑞利和莱斯衰落信道条件下，其传输量始终保持在容量预算之内。这些结果表明，将VLA推理与无线通信进行协同设计，是面向6G连接机器人技术的可行发展方向。

Authors: Boliang Liu, Wint Yi Poe, Jingyun Di, Riccardo Trivisonno, Giuseppe Caire

WorldAgen: Unified State-Action Prediction with Test-Time World Model Training VLA

Vision-Language-Action Test-Time Training World Model Action Prediction Transformer

简要说明：WorldAgen 提出了一种共享 Transformer 骨干网的 VLA 框架，联合学习世界建模与动作预测，并通过测试时训练（TTT）在探索性动作上进行适应性调整，在 CALVIN 和 LIBERO 基准上达到最先进水平。

TLDR: WorldAgen proposes a VLA framework with a shared Transformer backbone that jointly learns world modeling and action prediction, and uses test-time training (TTT) on exploratory actions to adapt to new environments, achieving state-of-the-art on CALVIN and LIBERO benchmarks.

Abstract: How can vision-language-action (VLA) models adapt to new environments where world dynamics shift? While recent research has combined world modeling and action prediction to improve VLA performance, existing methods largely rely on pretraining on static datasets, without mechanisms for active adaptation at deployment time. As a result, these models often fail to generalize when deployed in unseen scenarios with novel object configurations or dynamics. We present WorldAgen, a unified framework that jointly learns world modeling and action prediction while enabling Test-Time Training (TTT) to adapt to new environments. WorldAgen employs a shared Transformer backbone with two heads: (1) a world model head that predicts future states from past state-action trajectories, and (2) an agent model head that predicts actions conditioned on task instructions. We design a Mixed Unidirectional Attention Mask to separate these two models. During test time, WorldAgen samples exploratory actions, collects ground-truth state transitions, and performs lightweight TTT updates to refine its world model. This adaptation improves the model's understanding of the environment and leads to more accurate action predictions. Experiments on the CALVIN and LIBERO benchmarks demonstrate that our baseline model achieves comparable, and in some cases superior, performance to current state-of-the-art approaches. Moreover, with TTT on a small number of samples, our method surpasses existing state-of-the-art models, highlighting the effectiveness of adapting world models at inference time.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型如何适应世界动态发生改变的新环境？尽管近期研究将世界建模与动作预测相结合以提升VLA性能，现有方法主要依赖静态数据集的预训练，缺乏部署时主动适应的机制。因此，这些模型在部署到包含新型物体配置或动态变化的未知场景时，往往难以泛化。我们提出WorldAgen——一个统一框架，可联合学习世界建模与动作预测，同时支持测试时训练（TTT）以适应新环境。WorldAgen采用共享Transformer主干，配备两个模块：（1）世界模型模块，用于从过去的状态-动作轨迹预测未来状态；（2）智能体模型模块，根据任务指令预测动作。我们设计了混合单向注意力掩码来分离这两个模型。在测试阶段，WorldAgen采样探索性动作，收集真实状态转移数据，并通过轻量级TTT更新来优化其世界模型。这种适应性增强提升了模型对环境的理解，从而实现更精准的动作预测。在CALVIN和LIBERO基准上的实验表明，我们的基线模型性能与当前最先进方法相当，甚至在部分场景中更优。此外，通过少量样本的TTT，我们的方法超越了现有最先进模型，突显了推理时适应性世界建模的有效性。

Authors: Chi Wan, Kangrui Wang, Yuan Si, Pingyue Zhang, Manling Li

SyncWorld: Visual Calibration Enables World Models as Zero-Shot Simulators WorldModel

action-conditioned world model zero-shot simulator visual calibration action-visual mapping policy improvement

简要说明：SyncWorld 提出了一种动作条件世界模型，通过视觉校准片段学习动作-视觉映射，无需再训练即可在未见环境中零样本模拟动作结果。

TLDR: SyncWorld introduces an action-conditioned world model that uses a visual calibration episode to learn action-visual mappings, enabling zero-shot simulation of action outcomes in unseen environments without retraining.

Abstract: World models are increasingly used as policy-in-the-loop imagination environments, where reliable rollouts require fine-grained controllability with respect to low-level robot actions. A key obstacle to scaling such models in robotics is that actions are not a universal language in pixel space: changes in visual environment, camera view, robot placement, or embodiment alter how the same numerical action manifests visually, leading to conflicting supervision under mixed training and brittle generalization at deployment. We introduce SyncWorld, an action-conditioned world model that serves as a zero-shot simulator across unseen environments without any additional training. SyncWorld leverages a visual calibration episode---paired frames and actions that showcase all the controllable degrees of freedom---to specify the setup-specific Action--Visual Mapping in context. Training with visual calibration contexts teaches the model to interpret actions through visual evidence and to leverage interaction history when explicit calibration is unavailable. Experiments show that SyncWorld can accurately simulate action outcomes in previously unseen settings, and that its capability of simulating rollouts enables test-time policy improvement without training.

摘要（中文）：世界模型越来越多地被用作策略闭环中的想象环境，在此类环境中，可靠的推演需要针对底层机器人动作实现细粒度的可控性。在机器人领域扩展此类模型的一个关键障碍在于，动作在像素空间并非通用语言：视觉环境、相机视角、机器人布局或具身形态的变化会导致相同的数值动作在视觉上呈现不同效果，从而在混合训练下产生冲突的监督信号，并在部署时引发脆弱的泛化能力。我们提出SyncWorld——一种无需额外训练即可在未见环境中作为零样本模拟器的动作条件世界模型。SyncWorld利用视觉校准片段（展示所有可控自由度的配对帧与动作）在上下文中指定具体场景的动作-视觉映射。通过视觉校准上下文进行训练，使模型能够基于视觉证据理解动作含义，并在无法获取显式校准时利用交互历史。实验表明，SyncWorld能够精确模拟前所未见环境中的动作结果，其推演模拟能力无需训练即可实现测试时策略改进。

Authors: Yuncong Yang, Zhengtao Han, Furkan Ozyurt, Zeyuan Yang, Han Yang, Junyi Cao, Haoyu Zhen, Yilun Du, Chuang Gan

Online, Reachability-Aware, Sampling-Based Motion Planning RLRobot

Sampling-Based MPC Reachable-Set Overapproximation Interval Arithmetic Safety Guarantees Racing Simulation

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于采样的MPC框架，通过在线区间计算可达集上近似来提供硬安全保证，省去了昂贵的预计算步骤，在仿真赛车中安全违规减少超99%，并成功控制真实模型赛车。

TLDR: This paper introduces a sampling-based MPC framework that provides hard safety guarantees via online reachable-set overapproximations using interval arithmetic, eliminating the need for expensive pre-computation and achieving a 99% reduction in safety violations in simulated racing while successfully controlling a real model racecar.

Abstract: Sampling-Based Model-Predictive Control (MPC) algorithms are a flexible class of controllers used for navigation on a wide range of robotic systems. Historically, such approaches have lacked hard safety guarantees, a shortcoming which we remedy in this work by computing guaranteed reachable-set overapproximations online with a fast, interval-based pipeline. We show that our method achieves similar performance to a state-of-the-art reachability-based planner without the need for the expensive pre-computation step, and can be scaled to systems that are infeasible using existing approaches. Finally, we demonstrate that our technique reduces safety violations by over 99% in a racing simulation and successfully controls a model racecar on real hardware experiments without crashes.

摘要（中文）：基于采样的模型预测控制算法是一类灵活的控制器，广泛应用于各类机器人系统的导航任务。历史上，这类方法缺乏严格的安全保障，而本研究通过采用基于区间分析的快速在线计算管道，实时生成可保证的到达集超近似，从而弥补了这一缺陷。我们证明，该方法在无需昂贵的预计算步骤的前提下，能够达到与当前最先进的基于可达性规划器相当的性能，并可扩展至现有方法无法处理的系统。最后，我们通过实验验证：该技术在赛车仿真中将安全违规率降低超过99%，并在真实硬件实验中成功控制模型赛车实现无碰撞运行。

Authors: Brendan Gould, Zhiyuan Zhang, Panagiotis Tsiotras, Samuel Coogan

CAST: Alternating State-Value Targets and Expanded Policy Gradients for Model-Based Reinforcement Learning RLRobot

model-based reinforcement learning state-value critic planner-guided behavior quadruped robot online planning

简要说明：CAST通过用状态值评论家替代动作值评论家，并使用规划器引导行为与当前策略想象之间的交替目标来训练，改进了基于模型的强化学习，并成功迁移到真实的四足机器人上。

TLDR: CAST improves model-based RL by replacing the action-value critic with a state-value critic trained using an alternating target between planner-guided and policy-imagined transitions, enabling effective transfer to a real quadruped robot.

Abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) is a family of RL methods that learn a model of the environment and use it for action selection, making it well suited to robotics due to its sample efficiency. Combining learned models with online planning can further improve action selection, as the planner can exploit the model to find better actions than the learned policy alone. Recent methods combining learned policies with online planning typically learn the value of the policy rather than the stronger planner-guided behavior. We present CAST (Critic with Alternating State-value Target), which uses planner-guided behavior to improve value learning while regularizing the value estimate with the current policy. CAST replaces the action-value critic with a state-value critic, trained using a target that combines a real planner-guided transition and an imagined transition under the current policy. The resulting value function corresponds to an alternating process between planner-guided behavior and the current policy, allowing it to benefit from the stronger planner behavior while being regularised by the policy being learned. We evaluate CAST on the DeepMind Control and HumanoidBench Suites against several state-of-the-art methods, and demonstrate successful transfer to a physical Unitree Go2 quadruped performing a dynamic handstand.

摘要（中文）：基于模型的强化学习是一类通过构建环境模型并利用该模型进行动作选择的强化学习方法，因其样本效率高而特别适用于机器人领域。将所学模型与在线规划相结合可进一步优化动作选择——规划器能利用模型找到比单独学习策略更优的动作。现有结合学习策略与在线规划的方法通常学习策略本身的价值，而非更强大的规划引导行为。本文提出CAST（交替状态值目标评价器），利用规划引导行为改进价值学习，同时通过当前策略对价值估计进行正则化。CAST采用状态值评价器替代动作值评价器，其训练目标融合了规划引导下的实际转移与当前策略下的模拟转移。由此产生的价值函数对应规划引导行为与当前策略的交替过程，既能从更强大的规划行为中获益，又能通过正在学习的策略获得正则化。我们在DeepMind控制套件和HumanoidBench套件上将CAST与多种先进方法进行对比评估，并成功将其迁移至真实Unitree Go2四足机器人完成动态倒立动作。

Authors: Pietro Noah Crestaz, Mohamed Yassine Kabouri, Nicolas Mansard, Andrea Del Prete

Graph-Based Safe Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Agent Systems with Time-Varying Topology RLRobot

safe multi-agent RL Control Barrier-Like Function graph attention network cooperative navigation time-varying topology

简要说明：提出了一种基于图的安全多智能体强化学习框架，用于时变拓扑下的协同导航，通过控制势垒类函数动作筛选层保证安全，并在真实差速驱动机器人平台上验证。

TLDR: A graph-based safe multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for cooperative navigation that uses a Control Barrier-Like Function action screening layer to enforce safety constraints and a GAT-based centralized critic for value estimation, validated on real differential-drive robots.

Abstract: This paper presents a graph-based safe multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework for cooperative navigation with time-varying topology. To address the critical challenge of ensuring safety in environments with sensing constraints, a safety-decoupled mechanism is introduced through a Control Barrier-Like Function (CBLF) action screening layer. This mechanism bridges the gap between discrete LiDAR perception and continuous safety constraints, ensuring that physical safety constraints are strictly satisfied regardless of the learning progress. Building upon this safety foundation, a unified structural architecture is proposed, integrating a attention-based actor and a Graph Attention Network (GAT) centralized critic. The actor utilizes a value vector reconstruction mechanism that explicitly encodes relative geometric relations through a collaborative tracking error matrix, enabling scale-insensitive policy learning under time-varying communication topologies. Meanwhile, the GAT-based critic models evolving interaction structures for accurate global value estimation. The proposed framework is validated on real differential-drive robot platforms, and experimental results demonstrate superior stability and safety in dynamic scenarios with limited fields-of-view.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种基于图的、面向时变拓扑下协同导航的安全多智能体强化学习框架。为解决传感约束环境中确保安全的关键挑战，通过引入基于控制屏障类函数（CBLF）的动作筛选层，设计了一种安全解耦机制。该机制弥合了离散激光雷达感知与连续安全约束之间的鸿沟，确保无论学习进度如何，物理安全约束均能得到严格满足。在此安全基础之上，提出了一种统一架构，集成了基于注意力机制的执行器与基于图注意力网络（GAT）的集中式评论家。执行器采用值向量重构机制，通过协同跟踪误差矩阵显式编码相对几何关系，从而在时变通信拓扑下实现尺度不敏感的策略学习。同时，基于GAT的评论家对动态演化的交互结构进行建模，以实现精准的全局值估计。该框架在实际差速驱动机器人平台上进行了验证，实验结果表明，在视场受限的动态场景中，该方法具有卓越的稳定性与安全性。

Authors: Xiao Sizhe, Dong Lijing, Bai Rui, Tan Xin

No Free Checker: A Survey of Verifiers for Robot Policies RLRobot

verifiers robot policies success detectors reward models reward hacking

简要说明：本综述从可用性和可信度两个维度对机器人策略（包括VLA模型）的验证器进行了分类与分析，发现没有验证器能同时实现高可用性和高可信度。

TLDR: This survey categorizes and analyzes verifiers for robot policies (including VLA models) along the axes of availability and credibility, finding that no verifier simultaneously achieves high availability and high credibility.

Abstract: A verifier for robot policies reads a candidate behavior and returns a score for how well it did, used both to evaluate vision-language-action policies and to train them. Verifiers range from success detectors and reward models to runtime monitors, safety filters, and temporal-logic specifications. We survey roughly 150 verifiers and compare them along two properties. Availability is how much a verdict costs, how early in a rollout the verdict arrives, and how often a verdict can be asked for. Availability rises as verdicts get cheaper, earlier, and denser. Credibility is how much a high score tells us about the task. Credibility falls as the judgment becomes gameable and self-serving. We group the verifiers by who supplies the judgment: human verifiers, rule-based and formal verifiers, learned and pretrained verifiers, and model-intrinsic verifiers. Across the four families, we find that credibility falls as availability rises. Regardless of who supplies the judgment, there is no free checker. We then examine what validates a verifier itself, and how much a high score tells us. Three measures appear in the literature: agreement with human labels, the performance of the policy it trains, and behavior under reward hacking. We close with nine metrics that make a verifier claim checkable, and coordinates for the verifiers still to be built.

摘要（中文）：机器人策略验证器读取候选行为并返回其执行效果的评分，既用于评估视觉-语言-动作策略，也用于训练该类策略。验证器涵盖成功检测器、奖励模型、运行时监控器、安全过滤器及时序逻辑规范等类型。本文调研了约150种验证器，并从两个维度进行比较：可用性指验证结果的信息成本、在策略执行过程中获取验证结果的时效性，以及可请求验证结果的频次——当验证结果更廉价、更早获取、更密集时，可用性随之提升；可信度指高评分反映任务真实完成程度的指标——当评判标准易于被操纵且具有利己性时，可信度随之下降。我们根据评判主体的不同将验证器分为四类：人类验证器、基于规则与形式化验证器、学习型与预训练验证器，以及模型内在验证器。跨四类验证器的研究发现，可信度随可用性提升而下降——无论评判主体是谁，都不存在免费的验证器。继而探讨了验证器自身有效性的验证方法，以及高评分所能揭示的信息量：文献中主要采用三类评估指标——与人类标注的一致性、验证器训练所得策略的性能表现，以及奖励篡改下的行为特征。最后提出九项可验证验证器声明的度量指标，并为尚待构建的验证器提供坐标参照。

Authors: Yang Wan, Xihang Yue, Zhirui Liu, Ziyuan Chu, Shuxun Wang, Yuhan Chen, Xiaonan Jiang, Xukun Zhu, Yubo Dong, Linchao Zhu

DCLP++: Learning to Navigate with Footprint Clearance and Relative Motion VLN

footprint clearance local navigation dynamic environments LiDAR reciprocal encoding

简要说明：DCLP++提出了一种局部导航框架，利用足迹间隙代替传感器距离进行激光雷达感知，并在动态环境中对有移动障碍物的场景进行了评估。

TLDR: DCLP++ proposes a local navigation framework that uses footprint clearance instead of sensor distance for LiDAR-based perception, and evaluates it in a dynamic environment with moving obstacles.

Abstract: We present DCLP++, a local navigation frameworkthat uses footprint clearance as the geometric basis for studying relative motion features in dynamic environments. Each valid LiDAR return is mapped to its shortest Euclidean distance from the filled robot footprint before reciprocal encoding, replacing distance from the sensor with distance to the occupied body. Radial measurementsor simulated planar relative velocities provide short-horizon features without static-dynamic labels in the policy input. A preliminary study uses a rectangular robot with a speed limit of 1 m/s among 20 moving obstacles. On 100 fixed validation tasks, two selected training seeds yield mean success rates of 42% with sensor rangeand 70% with footprint clearance after 200,000 environment steps.Motion variants show mixed additional gains. These results supportthe clearance-based observation in the evaluated setting; reliable motion benefits and transfer across robots require further evaluation.

摘要（中文）：本文提出DCLP++，一种基于足迹间隙作为几何基础、研究动态环境中相对运动特征的局部导航框架。在互逆编码之前，每个有效的激光雷达回波点均被映射至其与填入式机器人足迹之间的最短欧氏距离，以距离占据本体的距离替代距离传感器的距离。径向测量或模拟平面相对速度可在策略输入中提供无需静态-动态标签的短时域特征。初步研究采用限速1米/秒的矩形机器人，在20个移动障碍物环境中进行测试。在100个固定验证任务中，两个选定训练种子经20万环境步后，基于传感器范围的平均成功率为42%，基于足迹间隙的平均成功率为70%。运动变体呈现出混合附加增益。这些结果支持了该评估环境下基于间隙的观测方法；但可靠的运动收益及跨机器人迁移能力仍需进一步评估。

BIFTA: Brain-Inspired Few-Shot Tactile Adaptation for Unknown Sensors Manipulation

few-shot adaptation tactile sensing sensor transfer spectral graph embodied interaction

简要说明：BIFTA 是一种受大脑启发的少样本触觉适应框架，通过冻结编码器、双视统计记忆和谱图修复，使得触觉感知模型能够在未知传感器间迁移，在未见过的触觉硬件上大幅提升准确率。

TLDR: BIFTA is a brain-inspired few-shot adaptation framework that enables tactile sensing models to transfer across unknown sensors by using a frozen encoder, dual-view statistical memory, and spectral graph repair, dramatically improving accuracy on unseen tactile hardware.

Abstract: Advances in tactile sensing have made contact-rich perception possible, accelerating progress in robotic manipulation, material understanding, and embodied interaction. However, because optical design, elastomer mechanics, and imaging geometry differ substantially across tactile sensors, models trained on known sensor types can suffer an abrupt performance collapse on unknown sensors. To address this problem, we propose the Brain-Inspired Few-Shot Tactile Adaptation (BIFTA) framework; it draws on the brain's rapid sensory adaptation mechanism to adapt a frozen encoder to an unknown tactile sensor from a small labeled support set. BIFTA preserves pretrained representations through dual-view statistical memory, constructs support-conditioned spectral graphs to repair sensor-dependent feature neighborhoods, and applies uncertainty-gated recurrent propagation to strengthen reliable cross-query evidence. Extensive benchmarks across three tactile datasets show that BIFTA substantially improves adaptation to unknown sensors: with only 10\% labeled target data on SITR, it raises mean Sparsh accuracy from 6.86\% for the frozen source classifier to 87.09\%, exceeding the strongest implemented prior comparison by 47.22 percentage points, and these gains generalize across datasets, pretrained backbones, and tactile tasks. These results validate BIFTA for data-efficient adaptation to unknown tactile sensors and offer a promising route toward tactile models that transfer across heterogeneous hardware.

摘要（中文）：触觉传感技术的进步使得富含接触信息的感知成为可能，加速了机器人操作、材料理解和具身交互等领域的发展。然而，由于不同触觉传感器的光学设计、弹性体力学和成像几何结构存在显著差异，基于已知传感器类型训练的模型在未知传感器上可能出现性能骤降。为解决这一问题，我们提出了脑启发的少样本触觉适应（BIFTA）框架；该框架借鉴大脑的快速感官适应机制，通过少量标注支持集将冻结编码器适应至未知触觉传感器。BIFTA通过双视角统计记忆保留预训练表征，构建支持条件谱图以修复传感器依赖的特征邻域，并采用不确定性门控循环传播增强可靠跨查询证据。在三个触觉数据集上的广泛基准测试表明，BIFTA显著提升了对未知传感器的适应能力：在SITR数据集上仅使用10%的标注目标数据，即可将Sparsh平均准确率从冻结源分类器的6.86%提升至87.09%，超出最强已有对比方法47.22个百分点，且该增益跨数据集、预训练主干网络和触觉任务均具有普适性。这些结果验证了BIFTA实现数据高效适应未知触觉传感器的有效性，并为构建跨异构硬件迁移的触觉模型提供了可行路径。

Authors: Boheng Liu, Ziyu Li, Xia Wu

CASD: Chunk-Aligned Semantic Distillation for Multi-StageRobot Manipulation Manipulation

Chunk-Aligned Semantic Distillation multi-stage robot manipulation vision-language model action chunks semantic targets

简要说明：CASD 提出了一种方法，利用离线视觉语言模型为整个动作块提取语义目标，从而在不进行在线 VLM 调用的情况下改进多阶段机器人操作策略。

TLDR: CASD introduces a method to derive semantic targets for entire action chunks using an offline VLM, improving multi-stage robot manipulation policies without online VLM calls.

Abstract: An action chunk can span several stages of a manipulation task, yet a label for its first step describes only the current stage. We introduce Chunk-Aligned Semantic Distillation (CASD), which derives semantic targets for entire action chunks. An offline vision--language model segments demonstrations into described stages. Their occupancy within each action chunk determines a weighted semantic target, including transitions between stages. A CASD generator learns to predict this target from the current observation, robot state, and task instruction. We then freeze the generator and train a policy conditioned on its predictions. The semantic branch runs once per policy query, without online VLM calls or reasoning-trace decoding. Teacher matching on annotated LIBERO training episodes is above chance for both single-stage and boundary-crossing chunks. We evaluate three Fast-WAM variants and a DreamZero integration across four benchmarks, including distribution shifts on LIBERO-Plus. Compared with published references, IDM+CASD reaches 98.9\% versus 98.0\% average success on LIBERO, while Uncond falls below its reference. Joint+CASD reaches 93.0\% versus 90.6\% on RoboTwin 2.0, and DreamZero+CASD reaches a 47.9\% four-category MolmoSpaces manipulation average versus 40.7\%. Performance varies across backbone integrations.

摘要（中文）：动作片段可跨越操作任务的多个阶段，但对其第一步的标注仅描述当前阶段。我们提出片段对齐语义蒸馏（CASD）方法，为整个动作片段生成语义目标。离线视觉-语言模型将示范过程分割为已标注阶段，这些阶段在每个动作片段中的占用率决定了加权语义目标（包括阶段间的过渡）。CASD生成器学习从当前观测、机器人状态及任务指令中预测该目标。随后冻结生成器，并训练一个以其预测为条件的策略。该语义分支在每个策略查询周期运行一次，无需在线调用视觉-语言模型或解码推理轨迹。对带标注的LIBERO训练集进行的教师匹配结果显示，单阶段片段与跨边界片段的准确率均高于随机水平。我们评估了三种Fast-WAM变体及一种DreamZero集成方法在四个基准测试（包括LIBERO-Plus的分布偏移场景）上的表现。与已发表参考文献相比：IDM+CASD在LIBERO上的平均成功率达98.9%（参考值98.0%），而Uncond低于参考值；Joint+CASD在RoboTwin 2.0上达93.0%（参考值90.6%）；DreamZero+CASD在MolmoSpaces四类操作任务中达47.9%的平均成功率（参考值40.7%）。不同主干网络集成下的性能存在差异。

Authors: Tinghe Ding, Jiahao Li, He Wang

Estimating Semantic Ambiguity via Gaussian Context Distributions for VLM-Driven Traversability Analysis AutonomousDriving

traversability estimation semantic ambiguity Gaussian Context Distribution uncertainty map VLM-driven navigation

简要说明：本文提出了一种将VLM语义歧义建模为高斯上下文分布的管线，为复杂户外环境中的自主导航生成密集的可通行性和不确定性地图。

TLDR: This paper proposes a pipeline that models VLM semantic ambiguity as a Gaussian Context Distribution to produce dense traversability and uncertainty maps for autonomous navigation in unstructured environments.

Abstract: Autonomous navigation in unstructured environments requires robust scene understanding, yet Vision-Language Models (VLMs) often suffer from semantic ambiguity, where conflicting predictions can lead to dangerous failures. To address this, we present a novel pipeline for vision-based traversability estimation that explicitly models contextual uncertainty. Our approach utilizes Conceptual Anchoring to ground open-vocabulary VLM predictions onto a continuous physical traversability scale. By formulating the model's responses as a Gaussian Context Distribution (GCD), we derive both a dense traversability map and a dense uncertainty map based on the statistical properties of the distribution. Experimental validation on the real-world GOOSE dataset demonstrates that our proposed uncertainty metric effectively correlates with sources of ambiguity, such as visual artifacts and mixed terrain overlap. The method exhibits competitive performance while offering the distinct advantage of providing statistical uncertainty estimates to address semantic ambiguity, enabling safer and more reliable autonomous behavior in complex outdoor settings.

摘要（中文）：在非结构化环境中的自主导航需要鲁棒的场景理解能力，然而视觉语言模型常常面临语义模糊性问题，其相互矛盾的预测可能导致危险故障。为此，我们提出了一种基于视觉的可通行性估计新流程，该流程显式建模了上下文不确定性。我们的方法利用概念锚定技术，将开放词汇的视觉语言模型预测映射到连续的物理可通行性标度上。通过将模型响应公式化为高斯上下文分布，我们基于该分布的统计特性推导出密集可通行性地图与密集不确定性地图。在真实世界GOOSE数据集上的实验验证表明，我们提出的不确定性度量能有效关联视觉伪影与混合地形重叠等模糊性来源。该方法在保持竞争性性能的同时，具有提供统计不确定性估计以解决语义模糊性的独特优势，从而在复杂户外环境中实现更安全、更可靠的自主行为。

Authors: Ramona Häuselmann, Mario A. V. Saucedo, Christoforos Kanellakis, George Nikolakopoulos

TASG-Explore: Traversability-Aware Sector-Guided Exploration for Ground Robot on Uneven Terrain Locomotion

autonomous exploration uneven terrain traversability analysis sector-guided planning ground robot

简要说明：一种针对不平坦地形的、具有通过性感知的扇形引导地面机器人自主探索框架，通过层次化地形分析和扇形引导规划器平衡探索效率、覆盖完整性和地形安全性。

TLDR: A traversability-aware, sector-guided exploration framework for ground robots on uneven terrain that balances exploration efficiency, coverage, and safety through hierarchical terrain analysis and a sector-guided planner.

Abstract: Autonomous exploration on uneven terrain requires ground robots to balance exploration efficiency, coverage completeness, and terrain safety. Detailed tsrrain reasoning improves local reliability but can slow large-scale exploration, whereas coarse region guidance expands quickly in open areas but can miss narrow passages and irregular traversable boundaries. To address this challenge, this paper presents TASG-Explore, a traversability-aware sector-guided exploration framework for ground robots. The framework first performs hierarchical traversability analysis using variable-voxel ground fitting and adaptive 8-bit obstacle encoding. It then splitting cost map into sectors, incrementally updates sector clusters, extracts terrain-coupled frontier viewpoints, and maintains a dynamic topological roadmap with unknown topological hypotheses. Finally, a sector-guided planner selects region targets and inserts local viewpoints to generate efficient exploration routes. Benchmark experiments in diverse challenging environments, including caves, forests, and rugged hills, show that TASG-Explore achieves the best overall performance among six representative state-of-the-art planners. The proposed traversability analysis improves processing efficiency by 6.3 times while maintaining high accuracy, and the exploration planner improves exploration efficiency by 51% and increases coverage by up to 2.95 times in rugged hill scene. Large-scale real-world experiments further demonstrate the practical value of the proposed method.

摘要（中文）：在崎岖地形上进行自主探索要求地面机器人在探索效率、覆盖完整性和地形安全性之间取得平衡。精细地形推理可提升局部可靠性，但会拖慢大规模探索速度；而粗略区域引导虽能在开阔地带快速扩展，却可能遗漏狭窄通道和不规则的可通行边界。针对这一挑战，本文提出TASG-Explore——一种面向地面机器人的可通行感知扇形引导探索框架。该框架首先通过可变体素地面拟合与自适应八位障碍物编码进行分层可通行性分析，随后将代价地图分割为扇形区域，增量更新扇形簇，提取地形耦合的前沿视点，并维护一个包含未知拓扑假设的动态拓扑路线图。最后，扇形引导规划器选择区域目标并插入局部视点，以生成高效的探索路径。在包括洞穴、森林和崎岖丘陵等多种具有挑战性的环境中进行的基准实验表明，在六种代表性先进规划器中，TASG-Explore取得了最佳综合性能。所提出的可通行性分析方法在保持高精度的同时将处理效率提升6.3倍，探索规划器在崎岖丘陵场景中将探索效率提高51%，覆盖范围最多增加2.95倍。大规模真实环境实验进一步验证了所提方法的实用价值。
