Authors: Shaocong Wang, Shiliang Shao, Ting Wang, Guangjie Han, Lianqing Liu

AURORA: Active Uncertainty-Driven Re-Orientation for In-Hand Reconstruction Manipulation

active 3D reconstruction in-hand manipulation next-best-view planning uncertainty estimation RGB-D fusion

简要说明：AURORA 是一个主动式手内三维重建框架，利用 Ray-GPIS 不确定性估计器驱动轴条件手内旋转策略，比非主动策略提升了重建质量和信息获取效率。

TLDR: AURORA is an active 3D in-hand reconstruction framework that uses a novel Ray-GPIS uncertainty estimator to drive an axis-conditioned in-hand rotation policy, improving reconstruction quality and efficiency over non-active strategies.

Abstract: Observing objects grasped by a robot hand is challenging due to severe visual occlusions. Although in-hand manipulation can expose hidden surfaces, existing approaches often rely on predefined or open-loop reorientation strategies that do not explicitly target under-observed regions. We propose AURORA, an active 3D reconstruction framework that closes the loop between online object-centric reconstruction and in-hand reorientation. At its core, Ray-GPIS estimates direction-wise reconstruction uncertainty along candidate viewing rays and selects next-best-view targets using an uncertainty--novelty objective, which are realized through an axis-conditioned in-hand rotation policy. The resulting RGB-D observations are fused incrementally using CAD-free 6D pose tracking and lightweight geometric reconstruction. Experiments demonstrate that AURORA improves reconstruction quality and information-acquisition efficiency over non-active rotation strategies, while Ray-GPIS also outperforms active view-planning baselines in reconstruction performance, action-ranking quality, and planning efficiency. Targeted ablations further validate its robustness to hand occlusion and pose errors. The project webpage is available at https://aurorahand.github.io/

摘要（中文）：机器人手部抓取物体的观测因严重的视觉遮挡而具有挑战性。虽然手内操作可以暴露隐藏表面，但现有方法通常依赖预定义或开环的重新定向策略，并未明确针对观测不足的区域。我们提出AURORA——一种主动式3D重建框架，该框架实现了以物体为中心的在线重建与手内重新定向之间的闭环。其核心在于，Ray-GPIS算法沿候选观测射线逐方向估计重建不确定性，并利用不确定性-新颖性目标函数选择下一最佳观测视角，这些目标通过基于轴条件的手内旋转策略实现。生成的RGB-D观测数据通过无CAD的6D位姿跟踪与轻量几何重建进行增量融合。实验表明，相较于非主动旋转策略，AURORA提升了重建质量与信息获取效率；同时，Ray-GPIS在重建性能、动作排序质量及规划效率上优于主动视角规划基线方法。针对性消融实验进一步验证了其对手部遮挡与位姿误差的鲁棒性。项目网页见https://aurorahand.github.io/。

Authors: Feiyu Zhao, Yuetong Li, Chenxi Xiao

Safe Task Planning with Long-Term Graph Memory for Embodied Agents VLN

safe task planning long-term semantic graph memory LLM-based risk predictor partial observability embodied agents

简要说明：SafeMem提出一种框架，通过从自我中心观察构建长期语义图记忆，使基于大语言模型的风险预测器能够评估高层动作并触发重规划，从而在部分可观测环境下实现更安全的完成任务。

TLDR: SafeMem proposes a framework for embodied agents that builds a long-term semantic graph memory from egocentric observations, enabling an LLM-based risk predictor to evaluate high-level actions and trigger replanning for safer task completion under partial observability.

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) have significantly advanced zero-shot task planning for embodied agents. However, most LLM- and VLM-driven methods struggle to generate safe high-level actions due to a lack of physical risk awareness, particularly under partial observability, where hazards lie outside the immediate field of view. To address this challenge, we propose a novel safe task-planning framework, SafeMem, which constructs and maintains a long-term semantic graph memory of the open and dynamic environment. Based on egocentric observations, the proposed framework incrementally accumulates knowledge about surrounding objects and their relationships with a graph. Then, an LLM-based risk predictor evaluates candidate actions using the graph memory, triggering a conservatism-modulated replanning loop with explanations for detected hazards. Extensive experiments on the IS-Bench benchmark and a real-world robot platform demonstrate that the SafeMem framework substantially improves safe success rates compared to state-of-the-art VLM-driven task planners. Video results are available on our webpage: https://sites.google.com/view/safemem.

摘要（中文）：大语言模型（LLMs）和视觉语言模型（VLMs）显著提升了具身智能体的零样本任务规划能力。然而，多数基于LLM和VLM的方法因缺乏物理风险意识，尤其是在部分可观测性条件下（即危险位于即时视野之外），难以生成安全的高层级动作。为解决这一挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的安全任务规划框架SafeMem，该框架针对开放动态环境构建并维护长期语义图记忆。基于自我中心观测，所提框架逐步积累周围物体及其关系的图知识。随后，基于LLM的风险预测器利用图记忆评估候选动作，触发带有检测危险解释的保守性调制重规划循环。在IS-Bench基准测试和真实机器人平台上开展的大量实验表明，与最先进的VLM驱动任务规划器相比，SafeMem框架显著提高了安全成功率。视频结果详见我们的网页：https://sites.google.com/view/safemem。

Authors: Siyuan Li, Taiyan Lang, Aoqi Yan, Jia Yu, Feifan Liu, Yihan Du, Yu Zheng, Xun Wang, Peng Liu

Localized Visual Feature Aggregation via Focus Pooling for Visuomotor Policies Manipulation

attention pooling visuomotor policies focus pooling proprioceptive context visual feature aggregation

简要说明：FocusPool 是一种注意力池化模块，根据机器人当前本体感知相关性选择性聚合中间 CNN 特征，在仿真和真实实验中策略成功率提升超过 36%，仅训练编码器参数的 5.8%。

TLDR: FocusPool is an attention pooling module that selectively aggregates intermediate CNN features based on proprioceptive relevance, improving visuomotor policy success rates by over 36% in simulation and real-world experiments while training only 5.8% of encoder parameters.

Abstract: Focusing on spatially localized, control-relevant visual cues has been shown to improve data efficiency in visuomotor policies by reducing the need to model task-irrelevant visual variation. Existing methods often impose this focus through input preprocessing, such as cropping control- or object-centric regions in RGB images or point-clouds. However, it remains underexplored whether such localized features can be exposed directly from commonly used convolutional neural network (CNN) encoded features. In this paper, we show that intermediate CNN features preserve localized visual context for control, but existing pooling methods fail to aggregate it effectively. We introduce FocusPool, an attention pooling module that selectively aggregates intermediate visual features according to their relevance to the robot's current proprioceptive context. The resulting pooled representation captures task-progressive, control-relevant local information and is used directly for policy learning. Across simulation and real-world experiments, FocusPool improves policy success rates over pooling and explicit local focus methods by 36.2% and 41.2%, with training only 5.8% of encoder parameters.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 聚焦于空间局部且与控制相关的视觉线索已被证明能够通过减少对任务无关视觉变化的建模需求，提升视觉运动策略的数据效率。现有方法通常通过输入预处理（如裁剪RGB图像或点云中关注控制目标或物体中心的区域）来施加这种聚焦。然而，是否能够直接从常用的卷积神经网络（CNN）编码特征中提取此类局部特征，这一问题尚未得到充分探索。本文证明，中间层CNN特征保留了用于控制的局部视觉上下文，但现有池化方法无法有效聚合这些特征。我们提出FocusPool——一种注意力池化模块，能够根据中间视觉特征与机器人当前本体感知上下文的相关性进行选择性聚合。由此生成的池化表示能够捕获任务递进式的、控制相关的局部信息，并直接用于策略学习。在仿真和真实世界实验中，FocusPool相比池化方法和显式局部聚焦方法，策略成功率分别提升36.2%和41.2%，且仅需训练编码器5.8%的参数。

Authors: Ruiyu Wang, Zheyu Zhuang, Danica Kragic, Florian T. Pokorny

A Multi-Modal Perception Pipeline for Object Detection and Tracking in Autonomous Racing AutonomousDriving

multi-modal perception object detection multi-object tracking autonomous racing late-fusion

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于自主赛车的多模态后期融合感知流水线，实现目标检测与跟踪，并在真实世界数据中验证了其在极限条件下的鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper presents a multi-modal late-fusion perception pipeline for object detection and tracking, designed for the challenging conditions of autonomous racing, and shows robustness in real-world data.

Abstract: Object detection and tracking are fundamental components of perception systems for autonomous driving. Achieving robust performance under adverse conditions such as limited visibility, sensor noise, and failures remains an open challenge, particularly in autonomous racing, where vehicles operate at very high speeds, experience strong vibrations, and interact under small safety margins. This paper presents a multi-modal late-fusion perception pipeline for object detection and tracking in the autonomous racing domain. The proposed system extends previous work by exploiting all onboard sensors through a late-fusion approach and a dedicated multi-object tracking framework. Independent detections from cameras, LiDARs, and RADARs are combined to provide timely and robust state estimates of surrounding vehicles. The tracking method explicitly compensates for detection delays and embeds in its model prior knowledge of vehicle dynamics and track layout. Experimental evaluation on real-world data across diverse critical scenarios, representative of challenging edge cases also in urban driving, confirms the effectiveness of the proposed pipeline and its suitability to support safe and adaptive planning decisions.

摘要（中文）：目标检测与跟踪是自动驾驶感知系统的核心组成部分。在能见度受限、传感器噪声及故障等不利条件下实现鲁棒性能仍是一项开放挑战，尤其在自动驾驶赛车领域——车辆以极高速运行、承受强烈振动并在极小安全裕度下交互。本文提出了一种面向自动驾驶赛车场景的多模态后融合感知流水线，用于目标检测与跟踪。所提系统通过后融合方法及专用多目标跟踪框架，充分利用所有车载传感器，扩展了先前工作。来自摄像头、激光雷达和毫米波雷达的独立检测结果被融合，以提供周围车辆状态估计的及时性与鲁棒性。该跟踪方法显式补偿检测延迟，并在其模型中嵌入了车辆动力学及赛道布局的先验知识。基于真实世界数据在多种关键场景（亦代表城市驾驶中的挑战性边缘案例）下的实验评估，证实了所提流水线的有效性及其支撑安全自适应规划决策的适用性。

Authors: Davide Malvezzi, Michele Pestarino, Vittoria Cavicchioli, Valentina La Gamba, Silvia Severi, Fabio Bagni, Luca Bartoli, Massimiliano Bosi, Francesco Gatti, Micaela Verucchi, Ayoub Raji, Marko Bertogna

EvoNav-Bench: Benchmarking Lifelong Navigation in Evolving Environments VLN

lifelong navigation evolving environments benchmark scene representation embodied agent

简要说明：提出了一个在随时间演变的环境中终身导航的基准，揭示了现有方法在此类条件下的失效，并评估了启发式适应策略。

TLDR: Presents a benchmark for lifelong navigation in environments that evolve over time, revealing that existing methods fail under such conditions and evaluating heuristic adaptation strategies.

Abstract: Lifelong navigation (LN) requires an embodied agent to solve a sequence of navigation subtasks in the same environment. Since solving each subtask from scratch incurs redundant exploration, an LN agent must consolidate experience from earlier stages and reuse it in later stages, often through persistent scene representations such as scene graphs or visual snapshots. However, existing approaches typically assume a stationary environment, whereas in real-world LN settings, human activities can cause the environment to evolve. With the stationary assumption violated, existing methods may fuse outdated prior observations with new observations, yet current benchmarks cannot reveal this failure mode. In this paper, we present EvoNav-Bench, which extends the GOAT-Bench style LN formulation in the context of evolving environments. Built on the ProcTHOR framework, EvoNav-Bench introduces environment modifications between navigation tasks, making prior experience useful but not fully reliable. This design enables controlled evaluation of how environment evolution affects LN agents that reuse prior scene observations. Using EvoNav-Bench, we benchmark three recent methods that build and reuse scene representations for navigation. We also compare three simple heuristic strategies for handling environment evolution: Frontier-Update, Fail-then-Update, and Stage-Reset. Our results show that existing methods are brittle under environment evolution, while the heuristic strategies enable a controlled analysis of how agents can adapt to scene changes and mitigate their impact.

摘要（中文）：终身导航（LN）要求具身智能体在同一环境中解决一系列导航子任务。由于从头开始解决每个子任务会导致重复探索，LN智能体必须整合先前阶段的经验并在后续阶段复用，通常通过持久化场景表示（如场景图或视觉快照）来实现。然而，现有方法通常假设环境是静止的，而在真实世界的LN场景中，人类活动会导致环境动态演变。当静止假设被打破时，现有方法可能会将过时的先验观测与新的观测相融合，但现有基准无法揭示这种失效模式。本文我们提出EvoNav-Bench，该基准将GOAT-Bench风格的LN范式扩展至动态演进环境。基于ProcTHOR框架构建，EvoNav-Bench在导航任务之间引入环境变更，使得先验经验虽有用但不再完全可靠。这种设计能够可控地评估环境演进如何影响复用先验场景观测的LN智能体。利用EvoNav-Bench，我们基准测试了三种近期构建并复用场景表示导航的方法。同时，我们比较了三种处理环境演进的简单启发式策略：前沿更新、失败后更新与阶段重置。结果表明，现有方法在环境演进下表现脆弱，而启发式策略则能够对智能体如何适应场景变化并减轻其影响进行可控分析。

Authors: Xilin Wang, Guoxi Zhang, Hongming Xu, Zhuofan Zhang, Tianxu Wang, Lifeng Fan

CALIPER: Clean Scenes Cannot Rank Physical Inference in Pretrained Visual Representations WorldModel

physical inference pretrained visual representations linear probe calibrated prediction world models

简要说明：CALIPER 表明，使用干净固定场景的标准物理推理基准无法区分预训练视觉表示是否真正推断物理特性，因为此类场景允许读取器利用像素位移；而 CALIPER 的校准预测测试结合变化场景和交换检查能提供可靠的模型排名。

TLDR: CALIPER reveals that standard physical inference benchmarks using clean, fixed-camera scenes cannot distinguish whether pretrained visual representations actually infer physics, because such scenes allow the readout to use pixel displacement; by contrast, CALIPER's calibrated prediction test with varying scenes and swap checks provides a reliable ranking.

Abstract: How far a pushed object slides depends on its mass and friction, which no single image reveals. Pretrained visual encoders are increasingly used as the perception front end of world models for manipulation, and their physical competence is assessed with perturbation benchmarks and linear probes, almost always in a clean, fixed-camera scene. We show that these assessments cannot distinguish an encoder that infers physics from one that does not. CALIPER (calibrate, then predict) is a direct test: an object of unknown mass and friction is struck twice at known speeds, a third strike is shown only up to the moment of contact, and a linear readout on frozen features must predict how far the object slides. Swapping in another object's calibration clips checks that the evidence is actually used. Across 2,000 simulated episodes and eight representations, from V-JEPA 2 to a randomly initialised ViT and raw pixels, calibration adds +0.50 R^2 and the swap removes it. Yet in the clean scene every representation lands within 0.02 R^2 of the ceiling set by true simulator state, because a fixed camera exposes the object's displacement directly in pixel coordinates. Resampling camera, lighting, and clutter for every clip spreads the same representations across 0.50 R^2; when the readout chooses a push speed for a goal distance, V-JEPA 2 misses by 4 mm and the random ViT by 20 mm, no better than ignoring the object. Linear probes track none of this: a change in frame aggregation moves a probe more than pretraining does, and erasing the probed mass direction from the same representation costs nothing in one scene and 0.35 R^2 in the other. Whether a benchmark can rank models is an empirical property, and we give three checks that establish it.

摘要（中文）：一个被推动的物体滑行多远取决于其质量和摩擦力，单张图像无法揭示这一信息。预训练的视觉编码器日益被用作操控世界模型的感知前端，其物理能力通常通过扰动基准测试和线性探针进行评估，且几乎总是在干净、固定相机的场景中进行。我们证明，这些评估无法区分能推断物理特性的编码器与不能推断的编码器。CALIPER（校准，然后预测）是一种直接测试方法：对一个质量和摩擦力未知的物体进行两次已知速度的击打，第三次击打仅展示至接触瞬间，并在冻结特征上使用线性读取器预测物体滑行距离。通过替换另一个物体的校准片段来检验证据是否被实际使用。在2000个模拟场景和八种表示（从V-JEPA 2到随机初始化的ViT及原始像素）中，校准使R²提升了0.50，而替换则消除了这一提升。然而，在干净场景中，所有表示与真实模拟器状态所设定的上限之间的R²差距均小于0.02，因为固定相机通过像素坐标直接暴露了物体的位移。对每个片段重新采样相机、光照和杂乱物体后，相同的表示在R²上分散了0.50；当读取器为目标距离选择推动速度时，V-JEPA 2的误差为4毫米，随机ViT的误差为20毫米，这与忽略物体本身相比并无改善。线性探针完全无法捕捉这些差异：帧聚合方式的变化对探针的影响大于预训练本身，而将同一表示中被探针的质量方向擦除，在一个场景中毫无影响，在另一个场景中则导致R²下降0.35。基准测试能否对模型进行排序是一个经验性问题，我们提供了三项检验来确立这一点。

Authors: Aman Mehta, Riya Baviskar

Dual-Layer Semantic-Spatial Belief Mapping for Aerial Object Goal Navigation VLN

Vision-Language Models Object Goal Navigation Belief Mapping UAV Semantic-Spatial

简要说明：AeroBelief 提出了一种双层语义-空间信念映射框架，将噪声较大的 VLM 观测转换为持久的空间引导，用于空中物体目标导航，在 UAV-ON 基准上取得了最优结果。

TLDR: AeroBelief proposes a dual-layer semantic-spatial belief mapping framework that transforms noisy VLM observations into persistent spatial guidance for aerial Object Goal Navigation, achieving state-of-the-art results on the UAV-ON benchmark.

Abstract: Aerial Object Goal Navigation (ObjectNav) requires an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) to locate a described target in an unknown outdoor environment using onboard visual observations. Vision-language models (VLMs) can interpret open-ended target descriptions and visual observations, but their frame-level outputs are often noisy, sparse, and spatially transient. We propose AeroBelief, a dual-layer semantic-spatial belief mapping framework that transforms transient VLM observations into persistent spatial guidance. It separates broad contextual plausibility from target-specific evidence: an intuition layer accumulates scene-level semantic cues for exploration, while an evidence layer preserves qualified target-specific observations for approach and confirmation. Evidence-gated fusion combines the two layers into spatial belief hotspots. We further introduce object-conditioned visual reasoning with conservative evidence qualification to improve observation reliability before spatial accumulation. In parallel, egocentric regional guidance converts quadtree coverage into UAV-centered, yaw-aligned directional proposals and stabilizes them through temporal commitment. Its regional scoring is independent of semantic belief values, maintaining exploration pressure and reducing repeated low-gain search. Experiments on the UAV-ON benchmark show that AeroBelief achieves the best reported overall SR, OSR, and SPL among the compared methods, reaching 21.61%, 35.57%, and 10.62, respectively. These results support the effectiveness of persistent semantic-spatial belief, conservative evidence qualification, and temporally stable regional guidance for aerial ObjectNav.

摘要（中文）：摘要：空中目标导航（ObjectNav）要求无人机利用机载视觉观测在未知室外环境中定位所描述的目标。视觉-语言模型（VLM）能够解读开放式目标描述与视觉观测，但其逐帧输出通常存在噪声大、稀疏且空间瞬时性强的问题。我们提出AeroBelief——一种双层语义-空间置信度映射框架，可将瞬时的VLM观测转化为持续的空间引导。该框架将宽泛的上下文合理性与特定目标证据分离：直觉层积累场景级语义线索以指导探索，而证据层保留经核验的特定目标观测以用于接近与确认。通过证据门控融合将两层信息结合为空间置信度热点区域。我们进一步引入基于目标条件约束的视觉推理及保守证据核验机制，在空间累积前提升观测可靠性。同时，以自我为中心的区域引导将四叉树覆盖图转化为以无人机为中心、偏航对齐的方向提议，并通过时间承诺机制实现稳定化。其区域评分独立于语义置信度值，从而维持探索压力并减少低收益重复搜索。在UAV-ON基准测试上的实验表明，AeroBelief在对比方法中实现了当前最优的综合成功率（SR）、目标发现成功率（OSR）及路径长度加权成功率（SPL），分别达到21.61%、35.57%和10.62。这些结果验证了持久语义-空间置信度、保守证据核验及时间稳定区域引导在无人机目标导航任务中的有效性。

Authors: Jianqiang Xiao, Xiang Deng, Yuexuan Sun, Yanjin Wu, Wenbiao Yan, Liqiang Nie

A Multimodal Label Forecasting Method for Aperiodic Visuo-Motor Time Series HumanoidEmbodied

humanoid locomotion egocentric vision proprioception time series forecasting fall anticipation

简要说明：本文针对非周期性视觉-运动时间序列预测，提出了一种多模态标签预测方法及两个基准数据集（仿真和真实硬件），用于人形机器人行走时的跌倒预测，在多个实验条件下比现有深度TSF方法有显著提升。

TLDR: This paper tackles aperiodic visuo-motor time series forecasting by proposing a multimodal label forecasting method and two benchmarks (simulation and real hardware) for fall anticipation during humanoid locomotion, showing significant improvements over prior deep TSF methods.

Abstract: Deep learning models have been increasingly applied to Time Series Forecasting (TSF) in recent years. Transformer-based and MLP-based models have both been used effectively on many real-world TSF regression benchmarks, and there is ongoing debate as to which family of methods is best. While these benchmarks have drawn much attention, it is also worth noting that many current datasets and methods assume approximate periodicity in the time series. In this work, we focus on a new TSF task without periodicity: anticipating falls during humanoid locomotion, on the basis of egocentric vision and proprioception. When the locomotion trajectories are sufficiently diverse, periodicity is violated. We contribute two new benchmark datasets (one from simulation, one from real hardware), showing that periodicity is violated and recent deep TSF methods struggle on these benchmarks. We also propose a novel deep learning architecture that exploits both endogenous and exogenous variables and a training process that rigorously enforces i.i.d sampling of training examples. Our results show statistically significant improvement over prior art in multiple experimental conditions, by 12.73% or more on the real data and 10.40% or more on the simulation data. Code and datasets will be available upon acceptance.

摘要（中文）：近年来，深度学习模型已越来越多地应用于时间序列预测（TSF）。基于Transformer和基于MLP的模型均已在许多真实世界的TSF回归基准测试中展现出有效性能，而关于哪类方法更优的争论仍在持续。尽管这些基准测试备受关注，但值得注意的是，当前许多数据集和方法均假设时间序列具有近似周期性。在本研究中，我们聚焦于一种无周期性的新型TSF任务：基于自我中心视觉与本体感知预测仿人运动过程中的跌倒。当运动轨迹足够多样化时，周期性即被打破。我们贡献了两个全新的基准数据集（一个来自仿真，一个来自真实硬件），结果表明周期性被打破，且近期深度TSF方法在这些基准测试中表现不佳。我们还提出了一种新颖的深度学习架构，该架构同时利用内生变量与外生变量，并设计了一种严格保证训练示例独立同分布采样的训练流程。研究结果显示，在多种实验条件下，我们的方法相较于现有技术实现了统计显著性的提升：在真实数据上提升12.73%或以上，在仿真数据上提升10.40%或以上。代码与数据集将在论文被接收后公开。

Authors: Borui He, Garrett E Katz

ActionSplice: In-Flight Action Editing for Interactive World Models WorldModel

Counterfactual State Transport action editing video world model chunk-autoregressive interactive world model

简要说明：ActionSplice 提出反事实状态传输（CST），在无需回滚的情况下实现分块自回归视频世界模型的动作即时编辑，通过轻量校正器将潜在状态向修正动作诱导的状态迁移。

TLDR: ActionSplice introduces Counterfactual State Transport (CST) to enable in-flight action editing for chunk-autoregressive video world models without rollback, using a lightweight corrector to transport latent states toward those induced by a revised action.

Abstract: Chunk-autoregressive video world models typically condition each generated chunk on one action. An action received during sampling must therefore wait for the next chunk, condition future solver evaluations on a state produced under the previous action, or trigger rollback that repeats completed evaluations. We introduce ActionSplice, an inference framework that formulates this problem as Counterfactual State Transport (CST). A lightweight corrector transports the interrupted backbone-native representation toward the matched state induced by the revised action at the same solver step. The world model and sampler remain frozen, and sampling resumes without replaying completed evaluations. The retargeting variant $\mathrm{CST}*{R}$ updates the entire active chunk, while the temporal-splicing variant $\mathrm{CST}*{T}$ preserves a temporal prefix and updates only the suffix. Across minWM-Wan Action2V and HY-WM1.5, $\mathrm{CST}*{R}$ reduces rollback-relative LPIPS by 61.5% and 75.9% relative to direct condition swapping. $\mathrm{CST}*{T}$ reduces suffix LPIPS by 56.1% and 77.5%, respectively, while providing $2.73\times$ and $1.69\times$ pixel-ready speedups over waiting. Under the HY-WorldPlay protocol, $\mathrm{CST}_{R}$ obtains a PSNR of 25.66 dB, an SSIM of 0.6902, and an LPIPS of 0.1337 against the original rollout.

摘要（中文）：块自回归视频世界模型通常使每个生成的块依赖于一个动作。采样过程中接收到的动作必须等待下一个块、将未来的求解器评估条件建立在先前动作产生的状态上，或触发回滚以重复已完成的评估。我们提出ActionSplice，这是一个将该问题形式化为反事实状态传输（CST）的推理框架。一个轻量级校正器将中断的骨干原生状态传输至由修正动作在同一求解器步骤下诱导的匹配状态。世界模型和采样器保持冻结，采样无需重放已完成的评估即可恢复。重定向变体$\mathrm{CST}*{R}$更新整个活动块，而时间拼接变体$\mathrm{CST}*{T}$保留时间前缀并仅更新后缀。在minWM-Wan Action2V和HY-WM1.5上，$\mathrm{CST}*{R}$相比直接条件交换将回滚相关的LPIPS降低了61.5%和75.9%。$\mathrm{CST}*{T}$将后缀LPIPS分别降低了56.1%和77.5%，同时相比等待提供了$2.73\times$和$1.69\times$的像素就绪加速。在HY-WorldPlay协议下，$\mathrm{CST}_{R}$相对于原始展开获得了25.66 dB的PSNR、0.6902的SSIM和0.1337的LPIPS。

Authors: Pardis Taghavi, Tingyu Guo, Jonas Lossner, Gaurav Pandey, Reza Langari

Rethinking Learned Occupancy in Autonomous Active Mapping with Observation-Gated Filtering Perception3D

learned occupancy active mapping observation-gated filter closed-loop coverage autonomous navigation

简要说明：本文发现，在自主主动建图任务中提高学习占位精度并不会单调提升闭环覆盖性能，并提出一种观测门控滤波器，通过选择性保留或抑制占位预测来提升规划表现。

TLDR: This paper diagnoses that improving learned occupancy accuracy does not monotonically improve closed-loop coverage in autonomous active mapping, and proposes an observation-gated filter that selectively retains or suppresses occupancy predictions to boost planning performance.

Abstract: Autonomous 3D active mapping requires a space robot to choose where to sense while building the geometry needed for navigation. Learned occupancy completion extends spatial context beyond the current field of view, but one predicted map often serves two planning roles: it scores expected surface gain and constrains collision-free motion. Unsupported occupancy can therefore distort both where the robot looks and where it believes it can travel. We study this coupled interface in a controlled closed-loop benchmark by holding the active-mapping system fixed and varying only its planner-facing occupancy across observation-only, learned, oracle-corrected, and ground-truth conditions. Improving occupancy accuracy does not monotonically improve closed-loop coverage: across 25 starts, planning with ground-truth occupancy reaches 70% of the learned baseline's final coverage 12.7 steps earlier on average, while increasing final coverage by only 0.031. Guided by this diagnosis, we introduce an observation-gated filter that retains completion in insufficiently observed regions and suppresses predictions only after repeated frustum exposure without nearby RGB-D support. The filter improves both targeted failure-prone starts without retraining or ground truth. These results motivate online revision of planner-facing geometry during autonomous intervals between communication windows. The current study assumes benchmark RGB-D observations and sufficiently accurate pose estimates; planetary sensing conditions and accumulated localization drift remain to be evaluated.

摘要（中文）：自主三维主动建图要求空间机器人在构建导航所需几何结构的同时，自主选择感知位置。学习型占据补全技术可将空间上下文延伸至当前视场之外，但单一预测地图通常需服务于两种规划任务：评估预期表面增益并约束无碰撞运动。因此，未经支持的占据信息会同时扭曲机器人对观测位置的判断及其对可行区域的认知。本研究在受控闭环基准测试中考察该耦合界面，具体方法为固定主动建图系统，仅改变面向规划器的占据信息——分别设置纯观测模式、学习模式、真值矫正模式及真实地况模式。实验表明，提升占据精度并不能单调改善闭环覆盖率：在25组初始位置中，基于真实地况占据进行规划时，达到学习基线最终覆盖率70%的平均步数提前12.7步，但最终覆盖率仅提升0.031。基于此诊断，我们提出观测门控滤波器：在观测不足区域保留补全结果，仅在重复视锥曝光且缺乏邻近RGB-D支持时抑制预测结果。该滤波器无需重新训练或真实数据即可改善特定薄弱初始位置的性能。研究结果支持在通信窗口间的自主时段对面向规划器的几何结构进行在线修正。当前研究基于基准RGB-D观测数据及充分精确的位姿估计，行星环境感知条件与累积定位漂移的影响仍有待评估。

Authors: Jiahui Zhang, Bonian Han, Gongbo Liang, Yu Zhang

FRAME: Factored Retrieval via Attribute Readouts for Object-Centric Scene Memory VLN

attribute-compositional retrieval scene memory language-guided robots object-centric readout

简要说明：FRAME提出用于语言引导机器人的属性组合检索方法，通过属性读出和查询感知加权，从持久场景记忆中高效检索具有多个持久属性的对象。

TLDR: FRAME proposes attribute-compositional retrieval for language-guided robots, using attribute readouts and query-aware weighting to efficiently retrieve objects from persistent scene memory by multiple persistent attributes.

Abstract: Language-guided robots need persistent scene memories to follow instructions, revisit objects, and resolve references to objects encountered over time. While much of language-guided scene-memory retrieval has emphasized spatial or relational references, many everyday object references specify objects by multiple persistent attributes, such as category, material, size, or surface appearance. We formalize this problem as attribute-compositional retrieval, where a fixed object-centric scene memory is queried with natural language to retrieve the object satisfying the requested attributes. To investigate this capability directly, we introduce a controlled evaluation protocol with fixed scene memories and attribute-defined targets, separating retrieval from perception and annotation ambiguities. We then propose FRAME, which turns language into query-relevant attribute weights, uses learned readouts to estimate per-attribute evidence from object embeddings, and ranks objects by aggregating this evidence according to the query. Across held-out scenes and object assets, FRAME outperforms representative scene-memory retrieval baselines while reducing post-decomposition object scoring to lightweight matrix-vector computation. These results position attribute-compositional retrieval as a complementary scene-memory capability for language-guided robots, showing that persistent object attributes can be exposed as composable evidence for accurate and efficient multi-attribute retrieval.

摘要（中文）：语言引导的机器人需要持久的场景记忆来执行指令、重新访问物体，并解析随时间遇到的物体指代。尽管多数语言引导的场景记忆检索研究侧重于空间或关系指代，但日常物体指代往往通过多个持久属性来指定物体，例如类别、材质、尺寸或表面外观。我们将此问题形式化为属性组合检索：用自然语言查询固定的以物体为中心的场景记忆，以检索满足所请求属性的物体。为直接研究这一能力，我们引入了一个受控评估协议，该协议采用固定的场景记忆和属性定义的目标，将检索与感知及标注歧义分离开来。随后我们提出FRAME方法，它将语言转化为与查询相关的属性权重，利用学习到的读出机制从物体嵌入中估计每个属性的证据，并根据查询聚合证据对物体进行排序。在未见过的场景和物体资产上，FRAME优于具有代表性的场景记忆检索基线，同时将后分解的物体评分简化为轻量级的矩阵-向量计算。这些结果将属性组合检索定位为语言引导机器人中一种互补的场景记忆能力，表明持久物体属性可以作为可组合的证据，用于实现准确且高效的多属性检索。

Authors: Woosang Jeon, Sanghyeok Choi, Minwoo Kim, Taehyun Jung, Taehyeong Kim

Real-time Puncture Detection and Recovery for Pneumatic Soft Actuators RLRobot

puncture detection soft actuators anomaly detection failure recovery IMU

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于IMU数据和异常检测的实时穿刺检测与恢复系统，用于气动软体执行器，并设计了故障恢复策略以维持驱动力。

TLDR: This paper presents a real-time puncture detection and recovery system for pneumatic soft actuators using IMU data and anomaly detection, along with a failure recovery strategy to maintain actuation force.

Abstract: Soft robots offer safe and adaptive interaction with humans and unstructured environments through their inherent ability to deform and comply. Pneumatic actuators are one way to build soft robots. They are typically made from soft silicone materials and are especially effective for driving such systems, enabling smooth and adaptable motion. However, their compliant nature also makes them vulnerable to mechanical failures like punctures and tears, limiting practical deployment. To address this, we propose a puncture detection system for soft actuators using motion data from a single inertial measurement unit. Extracted features are used to train anomaly detectors for puncture detection and non-linear models to estimate severity. We also introduce a multi-chamber pneumatic soft bending actuator capable of diverse configurations via selective chamber inflation. Our algorithm identifies the punctured chamber and provides a severity score using a chamber perturbation scheme. Anomaly detectors are trained on normal operation data and detect damage through reconstruction errors, while severity is estimated by a separate model trained under slightly modified conditions. Finally, we demonstrate a failure recovery strategy to maintain actuation force post-failure. This approach enhances the reliability and safety of soft robotic systems through real-time, data-driven damage detection.

摘要（中文）：软体机器人凭借其固有的变形与顺应能力，能够与人类及非结构化环境实现安全且自适应的交互。气动执行器是构建软体机器人的一种方式。它们通常由柔软的硅胶材料制成，在驱动此类系统时尤为有效，能够实现平滑且可适应的运动。然而，其顺应性也使其易受穿刺和撕裂等机械故障影响，限制了实际应用。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种基于单个惯性测量单元运动数据的软体执行器穿刺检测系统。通过提取特征，我们训练异常检测器进行穿刺检测，并利用非线性模型评估损伤严重程度。我们还引入了一种多腔室气动软体弯曲执行器，可通过选择性腔室充气实现多种构型。我们的算法能够识别被穿刺的腔室，并利用腔室扰动方案提供严重程度评分。异常检测器基于正常运行数据进行训练，通过重构误差检测损伤，而严重程度则由在略微修改条件下训练的独立模型进行估计。最后，我们展示了一种故障恢复策略，以在故障发生后维持驱动力。该方法通过实时、数据驱动的损伤检测，提升了软体机器人系统的可靠性与安全性。

Authors: Tejonidhi R. Deshpande, Tingyu Cheng, Josiah Hester

SUN: Reaching for Novelty in Reinforcement Learning RLRobot

goal-conditioned RL successor value functions novelty reachability exploration

简要说明：本文提出了SUccessor-to-Novelty（SUN），一种基于后继价值函数的强化学习目标选择框架，显式平衡新穎性和可达性，提升了存在不可达或难以达状态的场景中的探索效率。

TLDR: This paper proposes SUccessor-to-Novelty (SUN), a goal-selection framework for reinforcement learning that explicitly balances novelty and reachability using successor value functions, improving exploration in environments with unreachable or hard-to-reach states.

Abstract: Exploration in reinforcement learning (RL) remains a fundamental challenge. Recent goal-conditioned RL strategies (which select goals to encourage broader state coverage) have shown promising results, but none scores a goal by novelty and reachability jointly: the two signals are traded off by hand, applied in sequence, or one is neglected outright. In this paper, we introduce a reachability-aware goal-selection framework that explicitly integrates these two aspects, and that can be seamlessly incorporated into any off-policy RL algorithm. To this aim, we propose SUccessor-to-Novelty (SUN), an indicator derived from successor value functions to identify goals that are both novel and reachable. We prove that SUN recovers count-based bonuses in the limit, bounds short-horizon hitting probabilities, and provably rejects unreachable goals. We further present an adaptive goal-selection strategy that leverages these properties, and an accurate yet lightweight pseudocount to avoid the overhead of classic methods. We back up all our claims with thorough benchmarks: SUN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in standard and novel environments with unreachable or hard-to-reach states, irreversible transitions, obstacles, mazes, and unbounded spaces.

摘要（中文）：强化学习中的探索仍是一个根本性挑战。近期基于目标条件的强化学习策略（通过选择目标以鼓励更广的状态覆盖）虽已展现出令人鼓舞的成果，但尚无方法能够同时以新颖性和可达性来评判目标：这两种信号要么被手动权衡，要么被顺序使用，甚至直接忽略其中之一。本文提出一种可达性感知的目标选择框架，该框架显式整合了这两个方面，并可无缝嵌入任何离策略强化学习算法。为此，我们设计了新颖性-可达性后继函数指标（SUN），该指标基于后继价值函数推导得出，能够识别既新颖又可达的目标。我们证明SUN在极限条件下可恢复基于计数的探索奖励，界定短时域命中概率，并能够严格拒绝不可达目标。进一步地，我们提出一种利用上述特性的自适应目标选择策略，以及一种精确且轻量的伪计数方法，以避免经典方法的计算开销。我们通过全面的基准测试支持所有论断：在包含不可达或难达状态、不可逆转移、障碍物、迷宫及无界空间的标准及新颖环境中，SUN始终优于现有最优方法。

Authors: Wenyan Yang, Arsenii Mustafin, Dominik Baumann, Joni Pajarinen, Simone Parisi

Multi-bounce Drum Roll with Optimized Active Tricks to Leverage Soft Embodiment Manipulation

soft robotic drummer multi-bounce drum roll Tap-Pull trick Micro-Pulse trick Bayesian optimization

简要说明：本文提出了一种软体机器人鼓手，通过优化的主动技巧（拉击和微脉冲）利用软体弹性实现高质量多弹跳鼓点，并使用贝叶斯优化进行性能调优。

TLDR: This paper presents a soft robotic drummer that uses optimized active tricks (Tap-Pull and Micro-Pulse) to achieve high-quality multi-bounce drum rolls by exploiting the soft embodiment's elasticity, with Bayesian optimization tuning for performance.

Abstract: This paper presents a soft robotic drummer for accurate and efficient drum rolls. High-frequency drum rolls require the "multi-bounce technique," where a drumstick bounces multiple times with a single stroke. In robotic reproduction of this technique, the body's elasticity is key, while the fine motion during the stroke is also crucial for maximizing the potential of that elasticity. Therefore, we design two tricks: i) Tap-Pull (TP) trick to increase the number of rebounds by adding a pulling motion after impact; and ii) Micro-Pulse (MP) trick to keep the drumming volume by injecting small oscillations during the stroke. Due to the nonlinear complexity of soft embodiment, both tricks are efficiently tuned using Bayesian optimization in a data-driven manner for accomplishing the respective objectives quantified. We evaluated the optimized behaviors with soft and rigid end-effectors. As a result, the soft TP achieved the highest bounce count (12.25 per stroke) with uniform intervals. The soft MP suppressed the volume decay, yielding 6.8-times higher acoustic efficiency compared to the rigid MP. These results indicate that the proposed tricks with the combination of elasticity and optimization can make robots play excellent drum rolls.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种用于实现精准高效滚奏的软体击鼓机器人。高频滚奏需要采用"多次弹跳技术"，即单次击打动作使鼓槌产生多次弹跳。在机器人对该技术的复现中，主体弹性是关键因素，而击打过程中的精细运动对充分发挥弹性潜力同样至关重要。为此，我们设计了两种技巧：i) 拍拉技巧，通过在撞击后增加回拉动作来增加弹跳次数；ii) 微脉冲技巧，通过在击打过程中注入微小振荡来保持击鼓音量。由于软体结构具有非线性复杂性，两种技巧均采用贝叶斯优化方法，以数据驱动方式高效调参，实现各自量化的目标。我们使用软体与刚性末端执行器对优化后的行为进行了评估。结果表明：软体拍拉技巧实现了最高弹跳次数（单次击打12.25次）且间隔均匀；软体微脉冲技巧有效抑制了音量衰减，其声学效率较刚性微脉冲技巧提升6.8倍。这些结果表明，所提技巧结合弹性特性与优化方法，可使机器人演奏出优异的滚奏效果。

Authors: Naoto Yamanaka, Takanori Jin, Taisuke Kobayashi

Bridging Language and Physics: Automated Design of Continuum Robots with Large Language Models Other

automated robot design continuum robots LLM simulation feedback iterative refinement

简要说明：提出AID-SR多层框架，通过将仿真器物理反馈传递给LLM，实现连续体机器人的自动设计，在仿真和真实世界中均取得高成功率。

TLDR: A multi-layered framework (AID-SR) that uses LLMs to iteratively design physically valid continuum robots by incorporating simulator feedback, achieving over 96% simulation feasibility and real-world fabrication success.

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently emerged as a promising tool for automating robot design from high-level specifications, yet they remain ineffective for robots operating under complex physical interactions. This limitation stems from the gap between language-based reasoning and the physical consequences of embodiment, often resulting in designs with low physical validity. In this work, we propose a multi-layered framework, AID-SR, that establishes a closed loop by translating simulator-observed physical states into structured feedback for the LLM designer. Combined with semantic critique, human feedback, and iterative refinement, the framework promotes the generation of physically feasible and functionally meaningful robot designs. We evaluate our approach on tendon-driven continuum robots across a benchmark of 14 tasks spanning reaching, grasping, locomotion, and manipulation. The proposed framework achieves 96.2% rate for passing the simulation feasibility check and by applying a common reinforcement learning training, 26.7% robots can successfully fulfill the corresponding task. We then fabricate three designed robots of AID-SR that successfully complete the task in real-world. These extensive experiments across simulation and real-world environments demonstrate and break the wall of utilizing the LLMs for automated design of continuum robots. The source code and experimental resources are publicly available at https://github.com/UNITES-Lab/AID-SR.

摘要（中文）：大型语言模型（LLM）最近已成为从高层规格自动设计机器人的一种有前景的工具，但对于在复杂物理交互下运行的机器人而言，其效果仍不理想。这一局限性源于基于语言的推理与具身化带来的物理后果之间的鸿沟，往往导致设计出的机器人物理有效性较低。在本研究中，我们提出了一种多层框架AID-SR，该框架通过将模拟器观测到的物理状态转化为结构化反馈，并输入给LLM设计器，从而构建了一个闭环。结合语义评判、人类反馈与迭代优化，该框架促进了具有物理可行性与功能意义的机器人设计的生成。我们以肌腱驱动的连续体机器人为对象，在涵盖抓取、移动与操控等14项任务的基准测试中评估了该方法。所提出的框架在模拟可行性检查中的通过率达到96.2%，并通过应用通用的强化学习训练，26.7%的机器人能够成功完成相应任务。随后，我们实际制造了三款由AID-SR设计的机器人，其在真实世界中成功完成任务。这些涵盖模拟与真实环境的广泛实验证明了利用LLM实现连续体机器人自动化设计的可行性，并打破了其应用壁垒。源代码与实验资源已公开于 https://github.com/UNITES-Lab/AID-SR。

Authors: Jingyi Chen, Mohan Zhang, Laura Yao, Yingtai Ni, Jianmin Ji, Jie Peng, Song Wang, Tianlong Chen

DISEIL: Demonstration Distillation for Sample-Efficient Imitation Learning Manipulation

imitation learning sample efficiency vision-language model failure mode classification task constraints

简要说明：DISEIL 提出了一种交互式模仿学习框架，利用视觉-语言模型和语言模型有意识地决定纠正哪个失败以及演示从何处开始，从而提高了在模拟机器人任务中的样本效率。

TLDR: DISEIL proposes a framework for interactive imitation learning that uses a vision-language model and a language model to deliberately decide which failure to correct and where to start a demonstration, improving sample efficiency in simulated robot tasks.

Abstract: A robot that can be taught a new task from a handful of demonstrations has to work out for itself what it still cannot do, and then ask for exactly that. Interactive imitation learning takes a step in that direction by letting a policy practice on its own and calling an expert when it goes wrong. Existing methods decide when to interrupt the learner. A further 2 decisions are left to whichever episode happened to trigger the interruption: which failure to correct, and where the demonstration should start. This paper is a first attempt at making both of them deliberately. DISEIL (Demonstration dIstillation for Sample-Efficient Imitation Learning) marks each failed episode at the step where the policy first becomes unreliable, represents that moment with a geometric descriptor, and groups the failures into recurring failure modes. A vision-language model and a language model read the selected mode and write a request for the next demonstration, and a store of task constraints checks that the request can be carried out before any expert time is spent. No model produces a robot action. Across 5 simulated tasks under state and image observations, changing only what the expert is asked for gives the highest mean held-out success rate in all 10 settings, with a tie in 1, and the margin is widest at the smallest budget we tested. The scope is narrow: a single round of practice at a time, in simulation, with experts that are mostly scripted. The longer-term aim is a learner that also tracks what its demonstration set already covers, and that asks a human teacher for the missing behavior in proportion to the effort each request costs them.

摘要（中文）：一个能从少量示范中习得新任务的机器人，必须自行判断自身尚不能完成的操作，并精准提出需求。交互式模仿学习通过让策略自主练习并在出错时调用专家介入，朝这一方向迈出一步。现有方法虽能决定何时中断学习过程，但其余两个决策仍需交由触发中断的具体回合来定：即应修正何种失败以及示范应从何处开始。本文首次尝试对这两项决策进行有意识设计。DISEIL（面向样本高效模仿学习的示范精馏法）在策略首次出现不可靠性的步骤标记每个失败回合，用几何描述符表征该时刻，并将失败归类为重复出现的失败模式。视觉-语言模型与语言模型读取选定模式后撰写下一次示范请求，由任务约束库在专家投入时间前验证请求可行性。所有模型均不生成机器人动作。在状态与图像观测下的五项模拟任务中，仅改变专家请求内容便能在全部10种设置中获得最高平均保留成功率（1种设置并列），且在我们测试的最小预算下优势最为显著。该研究范围有限：每次仅进行单轮练习，在模拟环境中运行，专家主要为脚本程序。长期目标在于构建能同步追踪已知示范覆盖范围的学习者，并能根据每项请求对教师投入成本的权衡，向人类教师请求缺失行为。

Authors: Suyog Khanal, Arun Kumar A, Santu Rana

Learning to Fly: Stable Vision-Guided UAV Servoing with Compact Target-Centric Cues and Reinforcement Learning RLRobot

visual servoing UAV reinforcement learning curriculum learning target-centric cues

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于强化学习的无人机视觉伺服方法，使用紧凑的目标中心线索（图像空间偏移、相对深度）结合低维传感器数据，并比较了课程学习策略以提升鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper presents a reinforcement learning approach for UAV visual servoing using compact target-centric cues (image-space offsets, relative depth) combined with low-dimensional sensor data, and compares curriculum learning strategies to improve robustness.

Abstract: Vision-guided reinforcement learning for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) remains challenging due to unstable policy optimisation, aggressive exploration, and the cost of high-dimensional visual perception. In this work, we investigate long-horizon UAV visual servoing using compact target-centric cues combined with low-dimensional sensor measurements. Rather than learning directly from RGB images, lightweight target segmentation provides image-space offsets and relative depth, which are combined with quadrotor velocity and projected-gravity measurements into a compact 12D policy observation. We compare Direct PPO with three matched-budget curriculum strategies: a Visual curriculum that progressively expands target placement difficulty, a Dynamics curriculum that gradually relaxes action constraints and smoothing, and a Joint curriculum that combines both progressions. All strategies reach comparable nominal performance, with complementary advantages across tracking metrics. Observation ablations show that proprioceptive measurements are critical for stable flight and image-space cues for target alignment, while explicit depth is not necessary for strong performance in the evaluated setting. Against tuned classical visual-servo controllers, learned policies show greater robustness to strong control and visual perturbations, while the Visual curriculum exhibits the smallest degradation under unseen target motion. Overall, the results demonstrate that compact target-centric representations can support robust long-horizon aerial visual servoing and that visual curriculum training can improve robustness to dynamic distribution shifts despite limited gains in nominal performance.

摘要（中文）：视觉引导的无人机强化学习因策略优化不稳定、探索过程激进以及高维视觉感知成本高昂而仍具挑战性。本研究采用紧凑型目标中心线索结合低维传感器测量，探索长时域无人机视觉伺服控制。与直接基于RGB图像学习不同，轻量化目标分割提供图像空间偏移量与相对深度，这些信息与四旋翼速度及投影重力测量值共同构成紧凑的12维策略观测空间。我们将直接PPO算法与三种匹配预算的课程策略进行对比：视觉课程（逐步扩展目标放置难度）、动力学课程（逐渐放宽动作约束与平滑度）及联合课程（结合上述两种渐进策略）。所有策略均达到可比的标称性能，在追踪指标上呈现互补优势。观测消融实验表明：本体感知测量对稳定飞行至关重要，图像空间线索对目标对准起关键作用，而显式深度信息在所评估场景中并非强性能的必要条件。与经调优的经典视觉伺服控制器相比，学习型策略对强控制扰动与视觉扰动展现出更强鲁棒性，其中视觉课程策略在未见过目标运动场景下性能衰减最小。总体而言，研究结果表明紧凑型目标中心表征可支持鲁棒的长时域空中视觉伺服，且视觉课程训练虽对标称性能提升有限，却能增强对动态分布偏移的鲁棒性。

Scene Graph-Driven Haptic Feedback for Safety Enhancement in Robotic Ophthalmic Surgery via Physically Simulated iOCT Manipulation

haptic feedback scene graph robotic ophthalmic surgery iOCT subretinal injection

简要说明：一种用于机器人眼科手术的触觉反馈系统，利用模拟iOCT中的场景图生成增强安全性的触觉提示，并通过使用物理模型和机器人的用户研究进行了验证。

TLDR: A haptic feedback system for robotic ophthalmic surgery that uses scene graphs from simulated iOCT to generate safety-enhancing tactile cues, validated via a user study with a physical phantom and robot.

Abstract: Robotic ophthalmic surgery offers high precision but introduces a "sensory gap" by decoupling the surgeon from their instrument, resulting in a loss of tactile feedback. This paper presents a novel haptic feedback system for subretinal injection tasks leveraging Scene Graphs (SG). The system bridges the sensory gap by analyzing a physically simulated intraoperative Optical Coherence Tomography (iOCT) feed to construct a real-time surgical SG. The SG serves as a semantic abstraction layer for the surgical scene, which is then utilized by a deterministic, rule-based engine to generate state-dependent haptic feedback on a robotic input device. The system was evaluated in a user study (N=16) using an anthropomorphic head phantom and a custom-built surgical robot. Results demonstrate that the SG-driven haptic feedback improved surgical precision, reducing needle alignment error by 14% (p = 0.044) and improving System Usability Scale (SUS) scores by 8% (p = 0.015), while maintaining comparable task completion times. A needle trajectory analysis revealed the emergence of a safer "Align-then-Approach" strategy, in which our haptic negative reinforcement prompted users to fine-tune the tool's trajectory before approaching the retinal target. This work suggests that SGs can effectively serve as the direct computational foundation for real-time, safety-enhancing context-aware haptic feedback in robotic microsurgery.

摘要（中文）：机器人眼科手术虽能实现高精度，但通过将操作者与器械分离而引入了“感知鸿沟”，导致触觉反馈的缺失。本文提出一种基于场景图（SG）的新型触觉反馈系统，用于视网膜下注射任务。该系统通过分析物理模拟的术中光学相干断层扫描（iOCT）数据流，构建实时的手术场景图，从而弥合感知鸿沟。场景图作为手术场景的语义抽象层，随后被确定性规则引擎用于在机器人输入设备上生成状态相关的触觉反馈。研究采用拟人头部模型及定制手术机器人开展用户实验（N=16）。结果表明，场景图驱动的触觉反馈提升了手术精度：针头对准误差降低14%（p=0.044），系统可用性量表（SUS）评分提高8%（p=0.015），同时任务完成时间保持相当。针道轨迹分析揭示了一种更安全的"对准-接近"策略的出现——其中触觉负强化机制促使用户在接近视网膜目标前对器械轨迹进行微调。本研究表明，场景图可作为实时、增强安全性的上下文感知触觉反馈在机器人显微手术中的直接计算基础。

Authors: Danial Arbabi, Korab Hoxha, Angelo Henriques, Mirza Imamovic, M. Ali Nasseri

RevalExo: A Functional Daily-Activity Benchmark for Inertial and Visual Locomotion Mode Recognition in Older Adults and Clinical Cohorts Locomotion

locomotion mode recognition inertial and visual exoskeleton control cross-population generalization knowledge transfer

简要说明：RevalExo 提出了一个针对老年人和临床人群的多模态步态识别基准，基于惯性和第一视角视觉数据，揭示了过渡识别和跨群体泛化的挑战。

TLDR: RevalExo introduces a multimodal benchmark for locomotion mode recognition in older adults and clinical cohorts using inertial and egocentric visual data, highlighting challenges in transition recognition and cross-population generalization.

Abstract: Assistive devices for people with mobility impairments, such as powered exoskeletons, rely on accurate locomotion mode recognition to adapt control strategies and provide appropriate assistance during daily activities. However, public benchmarks are typically collected from healthy adults, lack temporally precise labels necessary for detecting mode transitions, or focus on a limited set of tasks. To support development and evaluation under realistic clinical constraints and daily mobility demands, we introduce RevalExo, a functional daily-activity benchmark for inertial and visual locomotion mode recognition. RevalExo is built around a standardized, clinically and ecologically validated daily-activity protocol reflecting the cumulative everyday mobility demands in ageing and clinical populations. The benchmark includes 27 participants across three cohorts: older adults without mobility impairments, stroke survivors, and older adults with probable sarcopenia. The full cohort was recorded with lower-body IMUs, while synchronized egocentric video was collected for a clinically feasible subset of 13 participants. RevalExo provides 10.1 hours of frame-level annotations across 11 locomotion modes, including 5.1 hours of paired inertial--visual recordings. We benchmark three challenges: unimodal and multimodal locomotion mode recognition across multiple horizons, cross-population generalization from older adults without mobility impairments to clinical cohorts, and vision-guided knowledge transfer to IMU-only models. Results confirm consistent gains from fusing inertial and visual inputs but reveal a substantial gap between general recognition ($\sim$93\% F1) and recognition during transitions ($\sim$68\% F1), alongside persistent challenges in cross-population generalization and cross-modal transfer. We release RevalExo to stimulate further research on these open challenges.

摘要（中文）：针对行动障碍人士的辅助设备（如动力外骨骼），需依赖精确的运动模式识别来调整控制策略，并在日常活动中提供适当助力。然而，现有公共基准数据集多采集自健康成年人，或缺乏检测模式转换所需的时间精准标注，或仅聚焦于有限任务类型。为支持在真实临床约束与日常行动需求下的系统研发与评估，我们提出RevalExo——面向惯性及视觉运动模式识别的功能性日常活动基准数据集。RevalExo基于标准化、经临床与生态学验证的日常活动协议构建，该协议反映了老年及临床人群累积的日常行动需求。数据集包含三组共27名参与者：无行动障碍的老年人、中风幸存者及可能患有肌少症的老年人。全体参与者均记录了下肢惯性测量单元数据，并对其中13名临床可行子集同步采集了第一人称视角视频。RevalExo提供涵盖11种运动模式的10.1小时帧级标注数据（含5.1小时惯性-视觉配对记录）。我们针对三个挑战进行基准测试：多时间维度的单模态与多模态运动模式识别、从无行动障碍老年人到临床人群的跨群体泛化能力，以及视觉引导向纯惯性模型的知识迁移。实验结果表明，融合惯性及视觉输入始终能提升性能，但通用识别（F1约93%）与模式转换期间识别（F1约68%）存在显著差距，同时跨群体泛化与跨模态迁移仍面临持续性挑战。我们已公开RevalExo，旨在推动上述开放性问题的深入研究。

Authors: Diwas Lamsal, Juha Carlon, Reinhard Claeys, Maxim Yudayev, Louis Flynn, Tom Verstraten, David Beckwée, Eva Swinnen, Mihai Bâce, Bart Vanrumste, Benjamin Filtjens

Mini-Batch Risk-Averse Deep Q-Learning: A Robot Navigation Case Study RLRobot

risk-averse Q-learning coherent risk measure mini-batch transition mapping hierarchical decomposition underwater robot navigation

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于小批量风险厌恶的深度Q学习方法，将一致性风险度量融入双DQN中，使风险敏感控制适用于超出表格方法的状态空间，并通过水下机器人导航案例进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper proposes a mini-batch risk-averse deep Q-learning method that uses coherent risk measures in a double DQN, enabling risk-sensitive control in state spaces beyond tabular schemes, and demonstrates it on an underwater robot navigation case study.

Abstract: We study the control of Markov decision processes in which the quality of a policy is evaluated by a dynamic, time-consistent Markov risk measure rather than by an expected discounted cost. The main obstacle to combining such measures with reinforcement learning is that a transition risk mapping depends on the transition kernel in a nonlinear way, and therefore cannot be estimated from a single observed transition. We remove this obstacle by employing mini-batch transition risk mappings: the mapping is applied to the empirical measure of $N$ independent next-state samples, and the result is averaged. The resulting mapping is again coherent. However, as an expected value of a function of $N$ next-state values, it admits an unbiased one-sample estimator. We embed this mapping into a double deep Q-network, analyze the two sources of estimation bias that arise, and obtain a risk-averse Q-learning method applicable to state spaces far beyond the reach of tabular schemes. The method is applied to an underwater robot navigation problem, in which a vehicle must visit collection points, gather stochastic information payloads, and deliver them at transmission points, while exposed at each step to the risk of destruction. A hierarchical decomposition delegates path execution to an exact graph search and confines learning to the high-level ``collect or transmit'' decision. A low-dimensional feature map, invariant under the symmetries of the problem, replaces the raw state--configuration encoding. In experiments on $300$ held-out environments, the resulting policies transfer to instance sizes never seen in training, and already $N=2$ reduces the upper semideviation of the outcome distribution while simultaneously improving its mean whenever the simulator is misspecified---an empirical counterpart of the duality between coherent risk measures and distributional robustness.

摘要（中文）：我们研究马尔可夫决策过程中的控制问题，其中策略质量通过动态、时间一致的马氏风险度量进行评估，而非期望折扣成本。将此类度量与强化学习结合的主要障碍在于：转移风险映射以非线性方式依赖于转移核，因此无法通过单次观测转移进行估计。我们通过采用小批量转移风险映射来消除这一障碍：该映射应用于N个独立下一状态样本的经验测度，并将结果取平均。由此得到的映射仍保持一致性。然而，作为N个下一状态值函数的期望值，它允许构建无偏的单样本估计量。 我们将该映射嵌入双深度Q网络中，分析了由此产生的两类估计偏差来源，并得到一种适用于状态空间远超表格方法范围的风险规避Q学习方法。该方法应用于水下机器人导航问题：机器人需访问采集点、收集随机信息载荷并传输至发送点，同时每步面临损毁风险。层级分解将路径执行委托给精确图搜索，并将学习限定于高层“采集或传输”决策。利用问题对称性不变的低维特征映射替代原始状态-配置编码。在300个留存环境的实验中，所得策略可泛化至训练中从未见过的实例规模，且当模拟器被错误设定时，仅需N=2即可减小结果分布的上半偏差，同时提升其均值——这是一致性风险度量与分布鲁棒性对偶性的实证体现。
